column1: One of the 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队’s more curious creations, the Ion Raptor is a hand built marque of battlemechs built with salvage from the Clan front lines. First debuting in 3053, the original Ion Raptor was built from the remains of a Masakari and a Crab. 设计 in collaboration with Sea Fox merchants, the Ion Raptor 5R is a return to VEST’s roots. Each 5R is hand built to order, mostly for select Solaris stables. 设计 to succeed in the Arena and on the battlefield, the 5R is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers for ranged combat while 4 IHML’s surprise anyone who closes in. 4 Streak LRM-5’s support the ER Lasers, but can engage targets at close range if required. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 离子猛禽是瓦伊宁工程与打捞队最奇特的作品之一，是使用氏族前线战场残骸手工制造的战斗机甲品牌。原型于 3053 年首次亮相，由 Masakari 和 Crab 的残骸拼装而成。与海狐商人合作设计的离子猛禽 5R 回归了 VEST 的根基。每台 5R 都按订单手工制造，主要供精选的 Solaris 马厩使用。5R 旨在竞技场和战场上都取得成功，远程作战装备一对增程大型激光器，近身敌人则会遭到四门 IHML 的突袭；四具 Streak LRM-5 支援增程激光器，必要时也可攻击近距离目标。 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: Developed by Rileys Rangers as an in house attack helicopter, the Trask proved successful enough that large quantities were sold to the Canopian armed forces and other mercenary groups. A 30 ton VTOL, the Trask can reach speeds of 160kph, thanks to its 160 rated XL引擎; while 5 tons of heavy 铁纤维装甲 装甲 provide heavy protection. The Trask TSK-01 is armed with a 中型X脉冲激光 Laser and a pair of 锁定式SRM-6's. 生物群系限制: 该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动: 10/15 格 / 300/450 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 150 15 左侧 120 15 右侧 120 15 后方 95 15 总计 500 75 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium
column2: Trask 是 Riley 游骑兵开发的内部攻击直升机，表现足够成功，随后大量出售给 Canopus 武装部队和其他佣兵组织。这架 30 吨垂直起降机由 160 级 XL 引擎驱动，速度可达 160 公里/小时；五吨重型铁纤维装甲提供强力防护。Trask TSK-01 装备一门中型 X 脉冲激光器和两具锁定式 SRM-6。 生物群系限制: 该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动: 10/15 格 / 300/450 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 150 15 左侧 120 15 右侧 120 15 后方 95 15 总计 500 75 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 中程

column1: The Challenger 主战坦克 was designed to combat the threat the Clans posed to the Inner Sphere. The Challenger was a joint effort between 卡隆工业 and 通用汽车; rather than possibly losing out on lucrative contracts trying to outdo one another, the two corporations teamed up to create a main battle tank that could stand up to a BattleMech. The tank was produced on Kirklin, Kathil, and Salem. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 320 45 左侧 260 45 右侧 260 45 后方 180 45 炮塔 300 45 总计 1320 225 特性：主战坦克
column2: 挑战者主战坦克旨在应对氏族对内层圈构成的威胁。它由 Kallon 工业和通用汽车联合开发；两家公司没有为了争夺高利润合同彼此竞争，而是合作制造出一款能够与战斗机甲抗衡的主战坦克。该坦克在 Kirklin、Kathil 和 Salem 生产。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 320 45 左侧 260 45 右侧 260 45 后方 180 45 炮塔 300 45 总计 1320 225 特性：主战坦克

column1: The Hellspawn was 设计ed in response to a call from the Federated Commonwealth for a modern, highly mobile, fire-support Battle机甲. The Hellspawn is built on an Endo Steel chassis and a 270 XL引擎 that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For protection, the Hellspawn is equipped with a 守护者ECM Suite and has six and a half tons of 装甲 that is barely adequate when compared to other medium '机甲s. This 3081 variant carries a Light PPC and ER 中型激光 in each arm. It's also equipped with a 守护者ECM Suite, 比格犬主动探头, and TAG. The Hellspawn-10SR also carries eight 改进的 Jump Jets, allowing for 240 meter jumps. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Missile 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 地狱犬的设计源于联邦共和国对现代、高机动性火力支援战斗机甲的需求。它采用内骨骼钢底盘和 270 级 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 97.2 公里/小时。为提供防护，地狱犬配备守护者 ECM 套件和六吨半装甲，与其他中型机甲相比仅勉强够用。3081 年型号在双臂各安装一门轻型 PPC 和一门增程中型激光器，同时配备守护者 ECM 套件、比格犬主动探头和 TAG。地狱犬 10SR 还安装八具改进型跳跃喷射器，可进行 240 米跳跃。 怪癖: 改进的 冷却夹套—导弹 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: Conceived as a long-range infantry support 机甲, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass 生产 without regard for its 设计 flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor 装甲; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the 设计. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion 引擎, the Jackrabbit carries 3.5 tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-9W to carry a Light AC/5 and a 锁定式SRM-2, both with a single ton of ammo. An ER 中型激光 rounds out the weapons. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 兔跃者被设想为远程步兵支援机甲，却在 Amaris 政变前几周才开始原型制造。它不顾设计缺陷而进行量产，导致这台 25 吨机甲火力贫弱、装甲糟糕，最终声名狼藉并绝迹。兔跃者由 150 级聚变引擎驱动，携带 3.5 吨铁纤维装甲，最高速度 97 公里/小时。内骨骼钢框架让 Jackrabbit JKR-9W 能携带一门轻型 AC/5 和一具锁定式 SRM-2，各自配备一吨弹药；一门增程中型激光器完善武器配置。 怪癖: 灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Axel 重型坦克 is based on the popular Rommel design, but uses an internal combustion 引擎. To make room for the 引擎, the tank is only protected by ten and a half tons of 装甲. The internal combustion 引擎 also reduces the top speed of the tank to 54 km/h. The tank was produced by engineers working for the 自由蛇夫座共和国. 生物群系限制：该单位因使用内燃机，无法在月球或火星生物群系部署。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 225 35 左侧 185 35 右侧 185 35 后方 120 35 炮塔 190 35 总计 905 175 特性：主战坦克
column2: 阿克塞尔重型坦克基于广受欢迎的罗梅尔设计，但采用内燃机。为了给引擎腾出空间，坦克仅由十吨半装甲保护。内燃机也将坦克最高速度降低至 54 公里/小时。该坦克由自由蛇夫座共和国的工程师制造。 生物群系限制：该单位因使用内燃机，无法在月球或火星生物群系部署。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 225 35 左侧 185 35 右侧 185 35 后方 120 35 炮塔 190 35 总计 905 175 特性：主战坦克

column1: A post-Jihad variant 生产 by Krupp Armament Works for the 球体共和国 in 3084, the production model 8R was based on the prototype SDR-8X that used during the liberation of Terra. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by a smaller 210 Light Fusion 引擎 - while its ground speed was reduced, the SDR-8R's ten Pitban LFT-20X 改进的 Jump Jets gave it amazing maneuverability. Carrying ten double heat sinks allowed the 8R to fire its twin 多元光学 ER 中型激光s and jump without fear of overheating. Boasting a very different look, the re设计ed 8R was also notable for being one of the first Spiders to include an ejection system. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
column2: 这是 Krupp 武器公司的圣战后型号，于 3084 年为球体共和国生产。量产型 8R 基于解放 Terra 时使用的原型 SDR-8X。它采用内骨骼钢底盘和较小的 210 级轻型聚变引擎；虽然地面速度降低，但十具 Pitban LFT-20X 改进型跳跃喷射器赋予 SDR-8R 惊人的机动性。十台双重散热器让 8R 能够发射两门多元光学增程中型激光器并进行跳跃，而不用担心过热。重新设计的 8R 外形截然不同，也是最早配备弹射系统的蜘蛛型号之一。 怪癖: 灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 0.99

column1: A Nova Cat 设计, the 50 ton Huntsman was 设计ed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An Omni机甲, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL引擎 with an Endo Steel Skeleton and 铁纤维装甲 装甲 giving the Omni机甲, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman E is armed with a trio of ER 中型脉冲激光s. A 小型脉冲激光 and a pair of 锁定式SRM-6’s provide additional firepower at close range. A 可伸缩刀刃 is a nasty surprise should enemies close distance with the Huntsman. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 猎手是氏族新星猫的设计，重 50 吨，为复兴行动和入侵内层圈而开发，于 3049 年开始生产。作为全向机甲，猎手围绕 250 级 XL 引擎建造，结合内骨骼钢框架和铁纤维装甲，为全向机甲提供 21.5 吨吊舱空间。底盘固定五具跳跃喷射器，进一步提升灵活性。猎手 E 型装备三门增程中型脉冲激光器，一门小型脉冲激光器和一对锁定式 SRM-6 提供近距离火力；敌人若靠近猎手，还会遭遇可伸缩刀刃。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: A Jihad era upgrade of the Succession Wars Partisan, the Partisan Air Defense Tank (Cell) upgrades the original ICE 引擎 to a Fuel Cell. The free weight is used to mount a C3 slave and upgrade the Autocannons to a pair of AC/2’s and a pair of LB-10X’s. AMS and heavier 装甲 rounds out the design. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 200 40 左侧 145 40 右侧 145 40 后方 100 40 炮塔 150 40 总计 740 200 特性：防空瞄准系统
column2: 这是继承战争时期党卫军防空坦克的圣战时代升级型。党卫军防空坦克（燃料电池）将原有内燃机升级为燃料电池，并利用节省的重量安装 C3 从机，将自动加农炮升级为一对 AC/2 和一对 LB-10X。AMS 与更厚的装甲完善了设计。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 200 40 左侧 145 40 右侧 145 40 后方 100 40 炮塔 150 40 总计 740 200 特性：防空瞄准系统

column1: ComStar refit of their vintage stockpile of Thors. Removing the 中型激光s, the Thor is left with only the 重击者火炮 Piece and 40 rounds of Ammunition. The 车辆 is enhanced with a C3i network computer to allow better communication with its Lance, in case an enemy unit gets too close. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 5/8 格 / 150/240 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 165 30 左侧 115 30 右侧 115 30 后方 115 30 炮塔 140 30 总计 650 150 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics
column2: 这是 ComStar 对库存老式雷神机甲的改装型号。拆除中型激光器后，雷神只剩下一门重击者火炮和 40 发弹药。车辆增装 C3i 网络计算机，以便与所属长机保持更好通信，防止敌方单位过度接近。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 5/8 格 / 150/240 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 165 30 左侧 115 30 右侧 115 30 后方 115 30 炮塔 140 30 总计 650 150 怪癖: 精准 武器 - 弹道

column1: Taking a cue from 玉鹰氏族’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’机甲’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized 装甲 coverage to see the Clan’s precious Omni机甲s and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III B configuration is a Fast Striker that features a ER 中型激光 retains the original Shadow Cat jump capability in removable omnipod Jump Jets 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 受到玉鹰氏族十年前推出的雷神 II 启发，新星猫科学家拆除了原影猫的固定跳跃喷射器，以释放宝贵重量。剩余吨位大多分配给吊舱空间，提升机甲的灵活性，其余部分则用于最大化装甲覆盖，确保珍贵的全向机甲和战士安全返航。影猫 III B 配置是一款快速突击型，配备增程中型激光器，并通过可拆卸全向吊舱跳跃喷射器保留原影猫的跳跃能力。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The '机甲's most prominent weapon is the TSEMP磁脉冲炮, which enable it to potentially disable an opponent. The cannon is backed up by a MML-3 and a single ER 中型激光器, and to fulfill its infantry support role, the '机甲 carries three heavy machine guns. The '机甲 is powered by a GM 210-rated extralight fusion 引擎, which gives it enough speed to keep up with most combat 车辆s. The '机甲's hull is protected by six and a half tons of standard 装甲 and standard CASE is protects ammunition stored in the left torso. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper
column2: 机甲最突出的武器是 TSEMP 磁脉冲炮，有可能使敌人失去行动能力。该火炮由一具 MML-3 和一门增程中型激光器支援；为执行步兵支援任务，机甲还携带三挺重型机枪。它由 GM 210 级超轻聚变引擎驱动，速度足以跟上大多数战斗车辆。机体由六吨半标准装甲保护，左侧躯干储存的弹药由标准 CASE 防护。 怪癖: 改进的 通信系统 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂

column1: Developed in the later years of the Jihad by the Jade Falcons, the Flamberge was based on an older experiment involving 部分机翼 technology. A 70 ton 全向Mech, the Flamberge is built around a 280-rated XL引擎 and an Endo Steel chassis with 13.5 tons of 装甲. 11 DHS are installed as standard, as are a pair of SRM-6's with 35 tons of podspace rounding out the design. The Flamberge A is armed with an ER PPC and a 大型脉冲激光 with 5 改进型跳跃推进器 boosting the designs mobility and 4 extra DHS offsetting the increased heat load. 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 火焰剑由玉鹰氏族在圣战后期开发，基于一项涉及部分机翼技术的早期实验。作为 70 吨全向机甲，火焰剑围绕 280 级 XL 引擎和内骨骼钢底盘建造，配备 13.5 吨装甲。标准配置为 11 台双重散热器、两具 SRM-6 发射器和 35 吨吊舱空间。A 型装备一门增程 PPC 和一门大型脉冲激光器，五具改进型跳跃喷射器提升机动性，另有四台双重散热器抵消额外热负荷。 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The '机甲's Primary Configuration weaponry includes a Class 5 转管自动炮 and an ER Small Laser found in the right arm. The Autocannon has two tons of ammunition is found in its right torso with CASE II. In its left arm is a single Large 变速脉冲激光. The Prime uses some advanced electronics to give it an advantage on the battlefield; these include a C3 boosted slave to increase its accuracy in combat, and an Angel ECM Suite, which gives the '机甲 some considerable electronic warfare capacities. 怪癖: Variable Range 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 主要配置的武器包括右臂的一门 5 级转管自动炮和一门增程小型激光器。自动加农炮的两吨弹药存放在右侧躯干，并由 CASE II 保护。左臂安装一门大型变速脉冲激光器。Prime 型使用先进电子设备获得战场优势，包括由 C3 增强的从机以提高作战精度，以及赋予机甲强大电子战能力的天使 ECM 套件。 怪癖: 可变射程瞄准 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: A proposed Dark Age overhaul of the classic Phoenix Hawk, the PHX-99 is a unique take on the standard Phoenix Hawk. Emphasizing 装甲 over mobility, the PHX-99 is coated in Hardened 装甲, reinforced by a Heavy Duty Gyro and Modular 装甲. To fit this in, the 引擎 has been downgraded to a 50-rated Fusion Core, forcing the 机甲 to rely on a pair of 改进的 Jump Jets for mobility. Armed with a Large X-Pulse Laser, a pair of ER 中型激光器 and a pair of ER Small Lasers, the PHX-99 is considered a failed prototype for a reason. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: PHX-99 是经典凤凰鹰的黑暗时代改造方案，对标准凤凰鹰进行了独特重制。PHX-99 强调装甲而非机动性，覆盖强化装甲，并由重型陀螺仪和模块化装甲加固。为容纳这些设备，引擎降级为 50 级聚变核心，迫使机甲依靠一对改进型跳跃喷射器机动。它装备一门大型 X 脉冲激光器、一对增程中型激光器和一对增程小型激光器，被视为失败原型并非没有原因。 怪癖: 改进的 通信系统 掉落成本乘数: 1.05

column1: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of OmniMechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Like the other Celestials, the Seraph makes use of a light fusion 引擎 and a small cockpit, though other newer technologies are present only in its weaponry. As with the other Celestials, a C3i Computer is included. The Seraph E uses two experimental 雷电20s, though it only has enough ammunition to fire each about nine times. Backing these up is a 短管PPC.
column2: 作为天体系列全向机甲中的轻型突击机甲，Seraph 以其吨位而言略显缓慢，但配备三倍强度肌肉组织，过热运行时速度可提升至 64 公里/小时。和其他天体机甲一样，Seraph 使用轻型聚变引擎和小型驾驶舱，其他新技术则主要体现在武器上，并配备 C3i 计算机。Seraph E 使用两门实验型雷电 20，但弹药只够每门发射约九次，此外还装备一门短管 PPC。

column1: The Raven X is a Capellan experimental refit of the Raven-3L upgrading nearly every portion of the 设计. column1: The Amarok is a unique assault 'Mech among the Clan Wolf touman, intended as a close combat 'Mech. It was built and conceived under Ramiel Bekker's idea of combating the Death From Above (or DFA for short) tactics being employed by 玉鹰氏族. However, lacking time he had to seek assistance from 海狐氏族 as he did with the Stormwolf. It was during his time with 海狐氏族 that he started to investigate the Hammerhead, a new Sea Fox 'Mech, and from that 'Mech he borrowed design choices that would later be a part of the Amarok. For example, the use of 加固装甲 for better protection and modified hand actuators for use in close combat.
column2: 阿马洛克是狼氏族图曼中独特的突击机甲，定位为近战机甲。它由拉米尔·贝克尔构想并设计，用于对抗玉鹰氏族采用的“死亡从天而降”（简称 DFA）战术。然而，由于时间不足，他不得不寻求海狐氏族的协助，就像设计风暴狼时一样。在海狐氏族期间，他开始研究锤头鲨——海狐氏族的新型机甲，并从中借鉴了后来成为阿马洛克一部分的设计选择，例如使用加固装甲提升防护，以及改进手部执行器以用于近战。

column1: The Pebble Crab started life with the 布雷克圣言会 before the Lyran Alliance and Federated Suns started buying it, and by 3080 it had spread to essentially every major military in the Inner Sphere and Periphery, which is a remarkable adoption rate for a 35-ton light. The reason is straightforward enough: putting two ER Large Lasers on a frame this small and keeping it functional requires fourteen heat sinks and leaves almost nothing else, but the result is a light mech that threatens targets well outside the range where most opponents expect to be shot at. It punches considerably above its weight class.
column2: 卵石蟹最初由布雷克圣言会开发，随后天琴联盟和联邦太阳开始采购；到 3080 年，它已扩散到内层圈和边疆地区几乎所有主要军队。对于一台 35 吨轻型机甲而言，这种采用率十分惊人。原因很简单：要在如此小的机体上安装两门增程大型激光器并保持正常运作，需要 14 台散热器，几乎没有余量，但结果是一台能在大多数对手预期射程之外威胁目标的轻型机甲。它的打击力远超自身重量级别。

column1: The Skulker Wheeled Scout is the much larger cousin of the Swift Wind scout car and originally based on the Heavy APC 设计. Due to it being larger than any scout car, it can act as a mobile communication outpost. With its advanced sensor suite which is tied to both its communication and targeting systems, it can navigate with only its sensors. While hot environments would normally wreak havoc upon its advanced electronics, the heat sinks from its 中型激光 cool the sensors while the laser is not in use. This allows it to operate in even the hottest environments where other scout 车辆s cannot. The Skulker comes with four and a half tons of 装甲 as standard. 生物群系限制: 该单位因使用内燃机，无法在月球或火星生物群系部署。 移动: 7/11 格 / 210/330 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 90 10 左侧 90 10 右侧 90 10 后方 85 10 总计 355 40 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors

As with many Jihad-era Falcon experiments, the weight freed up by the removal of the HAG and its ammo was used to allow the Shadow Cat II 2 to mount a '机甲 scale 部分机翼 to enhance its jump distance. The Shadow Cat II 2 variant retains the LRM-10 launchers and ER 中型激光 of the first variant. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: Shadow Cat II以较轻的Shadow Cat全向机甲为基础，是雪鸦氏族的重型火力支援战斗机甲。作为3077年部署的实验技术变型，Shadow Cat II 2用一门ER大型激光和一门ER中型脉冲激光替换HAG，两者都配备光谱偏转护盾。与许多圣战时期的猎鹰实验型号一样，拆除HAG及其弹药后腾出的重量用于安装机甲级机械臂，以增加跳跃距离。Shadow Cat II 2保留第一变型的LRM-10发射器和ER中型激光器。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 上臂

column1: Developed in the later years of the Jihad by the Jade Falcons, the Flamberge was based on an older experiment involving 部分机翼 technology. A 70 ton 全向Mech, the Flamberge is built around a 280-rated XL引擎 and an Endo Steel chassis with 13.5 tons of 装甲. 11 DHS are installed as standard, as are a pair of SRM-6's with 35 tons of podspace rounding out the design. The Flamberge D is armed with a pair of IS 等离子步枪s and 4 Medium pulse Lasers with 4 Jump Jets boosting the designs mobility and 5 extra DHS offsetting the increased heat load. 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 猎鹰之爪在圣战后期由玉鹰氏族开发，源自早期的机械臂技术实验。作为一台70吨全向机甲，Flamberge以280额定XL引擎为核心，采用内骨骼底盘并配备13.5吨装甲。标准配置安装11组双重散热器和两具SRM-6发射器，并提供35吨舱位。Flamberge D装备两门内天体高斯步枪和4门中型脉冲激光器，4具跳跃喷射器提升机动性，额外5组双重散热器则抵消增加的热负荷。 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Developed in the later years of the Jihad by the Jade Falcons, the Flamberge was based on an older experiment involving 部分机翼 technology. A 70 ton 全向Mech, the Flamberge is built around a 280-rated XL引擎 and an Endo Steel chassis with 13.5 tons of 装甲. 11 DHS are installed as standard, as are a pair of SRM-6's with 35 tons of podspace rounding out the design. The Flamberge B is armed with an ER PPC and a 大型脉冲激光 with 4 Jump Jets boosting the designs mobility and 4 extra DHS offsetting the increased heat load. 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 猎鹰之爪在圣战后期由玉鹰氏族开发，源自早期的机械臂技术实验。作为一台70吨全向机甲，Flamberge以280额定XL引擎为核心，采用内骨骼底盘并配备13.5吨装甲。标准配置安装11组双重散热器和两具SRM-6发射器，并提供35吨舱位。Flamberge B装备一门ER PPC和一门中型脉冲激光器，4具跳跃喷射器提升机动性，额外4组双重散热器则抵消增加的热负荷。 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Following the start of the Jihad, the Luthien 装甲 Works on Abiy Adi began upgrading the Jenner. Borrowing a page from the Clan Jenner, the C2 is armed with three MML 5s, making the '机甲 effective at all ranges with three tons of ammunition. 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 was added as well, while in order to make room for this an XL引擎, XL Gyro, and 小型驾驶舱 were used. A C3 Slave Unit allows it to share targeting data with other members of its lance. Finally, the jump capacity is increased to 180 米. 怪癖: 改进的 Lifesupport 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 圣战开始后，Abiy Adi的Luthien装甲工坊开始升级Jenner。借鉴氏族Jenner的设计，C2装备三具MML-5发射器，配备三吨弹药后可在所有射程作战。它还增设重型铁纤维装甲；为腾出空间，采用XL引擎、XL陀螺仪和小型驾驶舱。C3从属单元使其能与小队其他成员共享瞄准数据。最后，跳跃能力提升至180米。 怪癖: 改进的 生命保障 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: This variant mounts a smaller 引擎 to free up the weight for an MML-9, with Artemis IV aid, as originally intended. It also replaces two of the ER small lasers with ER 中型激光s for greatly improved combat abilities. The 2N removes the CASE for extra 装甲, and any goodwill Cosara earned with the enhanced weapons bay was lost after they moved the missile ammunition into the heavily 装甲ed legs, raising concerns from 机甲Warriors that MASC overloads could cause the munitions to explode. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这一变型采用更小的引擎，为原计划安装的MML-9腾出重量，并配备Artemis IV辅助系统。它还用ER中型激光器替换两门ER小型激光器，大幅提升战斗能力。2N拆除CASE以换取额外装甲；Cosara在增强武器舱后赢得的善意也随之消失，因为他们把导弹弹药移入重装甲腿部，导致氏族战士担心MASC过载可能引爆弹药。 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: An unusual Clan 设计, the Tercio 4 is almost fully focused on very long range, indirect fire. This is achieved by mounting a 长 Tom 火炮 and two Arrow IV launchers, all with both standard and specialised ammunition to control the battlefield. Two Artemis V LRM-20 launchers can be use for direct fire if the '机甲 is directly engaged, but no other defensive weapons are provided and the 300 rated compact 引擎 means the Superheavy is very slow to maneuver out of harms way. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.47 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 作为一款不同寻常的氏族战斗机甲，Tercio 4几乎完全专注于超远程间接火力。它安装一门长汤炮和两具Arrow IV发射器，并为所有武器配备标准及特种弹药以控制战场。若机甲遭到直接交战，两具Artemis V LRM-20发射器可用于直射；除此之外没有任何防御武器，而300额定紧凑型引擎使这台超重型机甲难以迅速脱离危险。 怪癖: 多重追踪 掉落成本乘数: 1.47 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: Developed by 机甲Warriors from Warrior House Dai Da Chi, this variant of the Ti Ts'ang uses several experimental systems to provide a '机甲 customized to their needs. Using a 小型驾驶舱 allows for a Supercharger to increase the ground speed of the '机甲. The Hatchet of the standard Ti Ts'ang is replaced with a Lance that can penetrate 装甲 in a single blow. Finally, the Small Lasers of the standard model have been replaced by 小型X脉冲激光 Lasers. For greater accuracy, a 定位 Computer is used. 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: Warrior House Dai Da Chi的氏族战士开发了这一Ti Ts'ang变型，采用多种实验系统，使机甲符合他们的需求。小型驾驶舱为增压器腾出空间，以提高机甲地面速度。标准Ti Ts'ang的战斧被长矛替换，可一击穿透装甲。标准型号的小型激光器则替换为中型X脉冲激光器。为提高精度，机甲还使用瞄准计算机。 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: Fast and versatile, the Light Tank is poorly suited to direct combat but has a variety of other uses. Trading speed or weapons for 装甲, the Light Tank can soak up a surprisingly heavy level of firepower. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 150 20 左侧 80 20 右侧 80 20 后方 60 20 炮塔 80 20 总计 450 100 怪癖: Nimble
column2: 轻型坦克速度快、用途多样，却不适合直接战斗；它还有许多其他用途。牺牲速度或武器换取装甲后，轻型坦克能够承受出人意料的猛烈火力。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 150 20 左侧 80 20 右侧 80 20 后方 60 20 炮塔 80 20 总计 450 100 怪癖: 灵活

column1: The Telesilla is a Majesty Metals design built around the 二元激光 Cannon, which tells you the Magistracy was willing to experiment with technology that most Inner Sphere manufacturers had quietly set aside for good reason. The original model went into MAF service despite mixed field trials, which is the kind of decision that makes more sense when you understand how limited Periphery procurement options were during the Succession Wars. The 511 upgrade addressed most of the structural complaints and turned it into a machine that actually delivers on what the original was trying to be.
column2: Telesilla是Majesty Metals设计的机甲，以星元炮为核心；这说明治安官辖区愿意尝试大多数内天体制造商因充分理由而悄然放弃的技术。尽管实地测试结果褒贬不一，原始型号仍进入MAF服役；要理解这一决定，就必须考虑继承战争期间边疆采购选项有多么有限。511升级型号解决了大多数结构问题，终于让这台机器实现了原始设计的目标。

column1: The personal 设计 of Feng Hu, the mastermind behind the concept of the Tian Xie Zuo, the F configuration is an attempt to turn the Quad into a true vanguard unit. Ten 中型脉冲激光s, a Light PPC and a M9 Gauss Rifle as weapons, while Hardened 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and a torso mounted cockpit makes the '机甲 considerably more durable than the other loadouts. The 设计s major survivability drawback is its XL引擎, which by protruding into the side torsos opens the core up for more chances to get hit. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.36
column2: F配置属于Tian Xie Zuo概念背后策划者Feng Hu的私人机甲，尝试将这台四足机甲变成真正的先锋单位。它以十门中型脉冲激光、一门轻型PPC和一门M9高斯步枪为武器，强化铁纤维装甲和安装在躯干内的驾驶舱使其比其他配置耐用得多。该机甲最大的生存性缺点是XL引擎：引擎延伸到两侧躯干，暴露核心并增加受击机会。 怪癖: 精准 武器 - 弹道 掉落成本乘数: 1.36

column1: A Regulan design built to emulate the Lyran Berzerker, the Neandertal is an 80 ton Battlemech designed around two concepts – speed and close combat. A 400-rated XL引擎 paired with TSM helps achieve the first objective, while a massive Hatchet makes the Neanderthal deadly in close quarters. The Neanderthal NTL-AG is armed with a pair of Snub Nose PPC’s augmented by a PPC Capacitor. A trio of Rocket Launchers provide additional punch in close quarters, while Guardian ECM rounds out the mech. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.14
column2: Neandertal是Regulan设计、用于仿制莱拉人的Berzerker的机甲，重80吨，围绕速度与近战两大理念打造。400额定XL引擎配合TSM实现高速，巨型战斧则让Neanderthal在近距离极其致命。Neanderthal NTL-AG装备两门短管PPC，并由PPC电容器强化；三具火箭发射器在近战中提供额外打击，守护者ECM则完善整机能力。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.14

column1: Designed during the Amaris Civil War as a command Mech, the 95 ton Nightstar would not see production until the chaos of the First Succession War. The Nightstar ceased production a year after it first walked off the factory line and would not see production again until the late 3050’s. Powered by a 285-rated XL引擎, the Nightstar 10D is armed with a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a pair of Clan ER Large Lasers. A Medium X-Pulse Laser provides extra firepower at close quarters. 特性：Command Mech 部署费用倍率：1.17
column2: Nightstar是在阿玛里斯内战期间作为指挥机甲设计的95吨机体，但直到第一次继承战争的混乱时期才投入生产。Nightstar在首台机体下线一年后停产，直到3050年代末才重新生产。Nightstar 10D由285额定XL引擎驱动，装备两门轻型高斯步枪和两门氏族ER大型激光器；一门中型X脉冲激光器提供近距离额外火力。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: Originating after the 17th battle of Hesperus II, the Fafnir II is the 设计ation given to a limited production run of custom Fafnir's created with battlefield salvage. Built by 迪法恩斯工业, the 100 ton Fafnir II FNR2-5-A is powered by a 300-rated 轻型引擎 and protected by 21 tons of Ferro-Lamellor 装甲. A pair of HAG/30's form the primary armament, with 4 ER 中型激光s for close range combat. A 定位 Computer improves the 机甲s accuracy. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Fafnir II源自赫斯佩洛斯II号第17次战役之后，是用战场回收件制造的小批量定制Fafnir的统称。由赫斯佩洛斯工业制造的100吨Fafnir II FNR2-5-A采用300额定紧凑型引擎驱动，并以21吨铁层叠装甲提供防护。两门HAG/30构成主要武器，4门ER中型激光器用于近距离作战；瞄准计算机提升机甲的射击精度。 怪癖: 稳定 武器s 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

Carrying an array of ranged weapons, the Assault Tank is 设计ed to smash targets at range. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲: Vehicle Stealth 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 270 40 左侧 240 40 右侧 240 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 220 40 总计 1170 200 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors
column2: 这是最慢的坦克类别，却拥有最厚的装甲和最大的武器。突击坦克搭载多种远程武器，设计目标是在远距离摧毁目标。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲: 车辆 Stealth 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 270 40 左侧 240 40 右侧 240 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 220 40 总计 1170 200 怪癖: 改进的 传感器

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-6C is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of ER Small Lasers. A 瞄准计算机 enhances the Laser’s accuracy while AMS defends against incoming missiles. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.05
column2: 猎鹰是在统一战争后为SLDF设计的侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。猎鹰FLC-6C装备一门ER大型激光器和两门ER小型激光器。瞄准计算机提高激光武器的精度，而AMS用于拦截来袭导弹。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Argus is first and foremost a close combat '机甲. For this reason, the Argus carries a 转管自动炮/5 and a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. The Argus has a single Machine Gun to defend itself against infantry attacks, and an LRM-10 launcher provides the Argus with some long range striking capabilities. The 转管自动炮/5 and the ER 中型激光s are linked to an advanced 定位 Computer which makes them extremely accurate. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 阿古斯首先是一台近战机甲。为此，阿古斯装备一门转管自动炮/5和两门ER中型激光器用于近战。它还配备一挺机枪以防御步兵攻击，并以一具LRM-10发射器提供一定的远程打击能力。转管自动炮/5和ER中型激光器连接至高级瞄准计算机，使其拥有极高的命中精度。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Intended for combating guerrilla units, the Bloodhound is armed with three ER 中型激光器 and a 锁定式SRM-6 launcher as its primary weapons. The Bloodhound carries a ER small laser as a secondary weapon. To dissipate the heat from the Bloodhound's weapons the '机甲 has 14 double heat sinks. For its intended mission and in an infantry support role the Bloodhound is a superb '机甲, but when facing other '机甲s the Bloodhound is woefully underarmed. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: 猎犬旨在对付游击部队，主武器为三门ER中型激光器和一具锁定式SRM-6发射器，另有一门ER小型激光器作为副武器。为耗散武器产生的热量，这台机甲配备14台双重散热器。对于既定任务和步兵支援而言，猎犬是出色的机甲；但面对其他机甲时，它的火力就远远不足了。 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.03

column1: The -4S variant, that first saw use during the FedCom Civil War, is intended for close-range combat. The vulnerable XL引擎 has been replaced with a sturdier Light Fusion 引擎, and has been re设计ed to use an Endo Steel internal 结构. The '机甲 is armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a Large Pulse Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a pair of ER 中型激光器. 怪癖: Hyper-Extending Actuators 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: -4S型最早在联邦-康联内战期间投入使用，定位是近距离战斗。脆弱的XL引擎被更坚固的轻型聚变引擎取代，内部结构也改为远端钢。该机甲以重型高斯步枪作为主武器，并由一门大型脉冲激光器、两门中型脉冲激光器和两门ER中型激光器提供支援。 特性：超伸展作动器 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: This variant removes the large X-Pulse laser and three ER 中型激光器 and replaces them with two 锁定式SRM-4 launchers and one 锁定式SRM-6 launcher. It also carries a supercharger-enhanced 引擎, but at the loss of one and a half tons of 装甲. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 该型号拆除大型X脉冲激光器和三门ER中型激光器，换成两具锁定式SRM-4发射器和一具锁定式SRM-6发射器。它还装备由增压器强化的引擎，但因此减少了一吨半装甲。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: A 28th century 设计 that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech 设计ed for brawling. The DRG-6FC is armed with a Gauss Rifle and an LB-10X, with an ER Large Laser and a pair of ER 中型激光s as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL引擎 and an Endo Steel Skeleton provide the weight need for the heavy payload, while CASE and a C3i computer add to the 设计s survivability. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 龙火是一台28世纪设计、于3058年首次量产的75吨近战机甲。DRG-6FC装备高斯步枪和LB-10X，并以ER大型激光器和两门ER中型激光器作为副武器。300级XL引擎与远端钢骨架为其沉重的武器负载提供所需重量空间，CASE与C3i计算机则提高了机甲的生存能力。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: This field refit was introduced during the FedCom Civil War. It simply replaces the 超级自动炮/10 with a standard Autocannon/10. The dropoff in rate of fire is offset by the ability to use Precision Ammunition. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 该野战改装型于联邦-康联内战期间推出。它只是将超级自动炮/10替换为标准自动炮/10，射速下降则由可以使用精确弹药来弥补。 特性：炮管拳 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The Fafnir was intended to become 迪法恩斯工业 of Hesperus' flagship Battle机甲. The slow assault 设计 serves as a platform for the pair of 'Thor's Hammers'. The Fafnir is built on a lightweight Foundation Type 220 Endo Steel chassis that is capable of supporting the Fafnir's massive weapons payload and 装甲 while weighing half as much as a standard chassis. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 赫斯佩洛斯的迪法恩斯工业原本打算让法夫尼尔成为公司的旗舰战斗机甲。这台缓慢的突击机甲作为一对“雷神之锤”的发射平台。法夫尼尔采用轻型Foundation Type 220远端钢底盘，能够承载其庞大的武器负载和装甲，重量却只有标准底盘的一半。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The 4GLS is a simple upgrade of the 2GLS which replaces both Large Lasers with two ER Large Lasers and the 中型脉冲激光 with an ER 中型激光. The saved weight is used to make the 4GLS capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty 米. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 4GLS是2GLS的简单升级型，将两门大型激光器替换为两门ER大型激光器，并将中型脉冲激光器替换为ER中型激光器。节省的重量使4GLS能够跳跃一百二十米。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: This variant replaces the SA-OS's Large Laser with an 中型X脉冲激光 Laser as well as the Ultra AC/5 with an Ultra AC/10. It also replaces the standard 装甲 with 铁纤维装甲 and replaces the chassis with a composite chassis. 怪癖: 受保护的驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper
column2: 该型号将SA-OS的大型激光器替换为中型X脉冲激光器，并将Ultra AC/5替换为Ultra AC/10。标准装甲也被铁纤维装甲取代，底盘则换成复合底盘。 特性：受保护的驱动器 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper

column1: The 4Z variant of the Pillager is built to provide an almost perfect long range sniper '机甲. The new Stealth 装甲 makes it harder to hit, as does the required 守护者ECM Suite. In order to do fit these changes, the '机甲 has had two 中型激光器 and the Large Laser removed. The remaining 中型激光器 have been upgraded to ER 中型激光器. The Pillager has also replaced the XL引擎 with a standard 引擎 and added CASE for more reliability, so the '机甲 can survive a side torso destruction. 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.18
column2: 掠夺者4Z型的设计目标几乎是一台完美的远程狙击机甲。新型隐形装甲和必需的守护者ECM套件都让它更难被命中。为容纳这些改动，机甲拆除了两门中型激光器和大型激光器，并将保留下来的中型激光器升级为ER中型激光器。掠夺者还以标准引擎替换XL引擎并加入CASE，提高可靠性，使机甲即使一侧躯干被摧毁也能存活。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: A departure from the attempt to emulate the Mad Cat, the 2A model removes the '机甲s arsenal and upgrades it with a new weapons mix geared toward close combat. The primary weapon is a rotary autocannon/5. This is backed up at shorter ranges by a 大型脉冲激光 and for point-blank combat, the '机甲 carries four 中型脉冲激光s. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 与仿制狂猫的思路不同，2A型拆除了原机甲的武器库，换装为适合近战的新武器组合。主武器是一门转管自动炮/5，较近距离由一门大型脉冲激光器支援；贴身作战时，机甲还可用四门中型脉冲激光器攻击。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A Draconis Combine 开发 Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL引擎 allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of 装甲 and 36 tons of weapons. The 分裂 SD1-OD is armed with an LB-20X and a pair of PPC’s. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 苏达是由龙骧联合开发的全向机甲，基于逆向工程的洛基与雷神全向机甲。360级XL引擎让它能够携带15台双重散热器、16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。苏达SD1-OD装备LB-20X和两门PPC。 特性：延长躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 350 XL引擎, the 70 ton Thunder THR-3L is armed with an Arrow IV along with two Extended-Range 中型激光器 and a Streak SRM-6 rack. TSM boosts the Mechs performance when running hot while Guardian ECM and 13 tons of Stealth 装甲 protect the Thunder, with CASE mounted in the 左侧 Torso. 特性：Cowl 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右上臂
column2: 雷霆是氏族入侵后由卡佩兰制造商设计并生产的第一款重型机甲。70吨的雷霆THR-3L由350级XL引擎驱动，装备Arrow IV、两门远程中型激光器和一具Streak SRM-6发射架。TSM在高温运行时提升机甲性能，守护者ECM与13吨隐形装甲保护机体，左侧躯干还安装了CASE。 特性：护颈 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右上臂

column1: Not designed for traditional combat, the Carrier is a force multiplier. Designed to support allies from range, the Carrier can hang back behind friendly lines where its lack of 装甲 isn't a concern. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 30 左侧 110 30 右侧 110 30 后方 110 30 总计 440 120 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: 运输车并非为传统战斗设计，而是用于放大部队战力的支援平台。它能从远距离支援友军，停留在己方战线后方；由于缺乏装甲，这样的位置正好可以避免其弱点暴露。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 30 左侧 110 30 右侧 110 30 后方 110 30 总计 440 120 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: The slowest Tank class, but carrying the heaviest 装甲 and biggest weapons. Carrying an array of ranged weapons, the Assault Tank is 设计ed to smash targets at range. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲: 反射涂层 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 265 40 左侧 235 40 右侧 235 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 210 40 总计 1145 200 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors
column2: 这是最慢的坦克级别，但拥有最厚的装甲和最大的武器。它携带多种远程武器，旨在从远距离摧毁目标。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲: 反射涂层 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 265 40 左侧 235 40 右侧 235 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 210 40 总计 1145 200 特性：改进型传感器

column1: First appearing in 3062, the IIC 3 was 设计ed by 钢蛇氏族 following their ejection from the Inner Sphere and is 生产 for them by 氏族钻石鲨. Based upon the original, the IIC 3 makes use of two Heavy Large Lasers, a 中型脉冲激光, and two 小型脉冲激光s; all of which are linked to a 定位 Computer. Twenty-two double heat sinks keep all the heat generated by the weapons under control. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.18
column2: IIC 3于3062年首次出现，由钢蛇氏族在被逐出内天体后设计，并由钻石鲨氏族为其生产。基于原型机，IIC 3采用两门重型大型激光器、一门中型脉冲激光器和两门小型脉冲激光器，全部连接至瞄准计算机。二十二台双重散热器负责控制武器产生的热量。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-4N is armed with a 中型激光, 2 Small Lasers and a pair of Machine Guns. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97
column2: 猎鹰是在统一战争后为SLDF设计的侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。猎鹰FLC-4N装备一门中型激光器、两门小型激光器和两挺机枪。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-4Nb-PP2 is armed with a 中型脉冲激光, a 中型激光 and an ER Large Laser. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99
column2: 猎鹰是在统一战争后为SLDF设计的侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。猎鹰FLC-4Nb-PP2装备一门中型脉冲激光器、一门中型激光器和一门ER大型激光器。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-4Nb-Saho is armed with a 中型激光 and a 大型脉冲激光. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.03
column2: 猎鹰是在统一战争后为SLDF设计的侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。猎鹰FLC-4Nb-Saho装备一门中型激光器和一门大型脉冲激光器。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-4P is armed with a 中型脉冲激光, 2 Small Lasers and an AMS. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99
column2: 猎鹰是在统一战争后为SLDF设计的侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。猎鹰FLC-4P装备一门中型脉冲激光器、两门小型激光器和一套AMS。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an 超级自动炮/10 and downgrading the LRM-20 rack into an LRM-15. 特性：防空瞄准系统 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂
column2: 由于它是“伟大之父”选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座IIC并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次IIC升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。该型号将高斯步枪换成超级自动炮/10，并把LRM-20发射架降级为LRM-15。 特性：防空瞄准系统 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂

column1: The Gùn is a moderately fast light 全向Mech which was designed by the Capellan Confederation as an Infantry Support 'Mech. Designed with 10 tons of pod space, the default configuration of the Gùn features a combination of anti-infantry and anti-vehicle energy weaponry. The 'Mech also features a 小型驾驶舱 and an XL Gyro. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：0.92 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 枪式是一台速度适中的轻型氏族全向机甲，由卡佩兰联邦设计为步兵支援机甲。它拥有10吨模块舱位，默认配置结合了反步兵和反车辆能量武器。该机甲还配备小型驾驶舱和XL陀螺仪。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：0.92 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。Powered by a 300-rated 轻型引擎, the Marauder II MAD-6A is armed with a UAC/10, paired ER PPC’s and 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂
column2: 掠夺者II于3012年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，将75吨重型机甲变成100吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到3030年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。掠夺者II MAD-6A由一具300级轻型引擎驱动，装备UAC/10、成对的ER PPC以及中型X脉冲激光器。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂

column1: This customized Merlin C keeps the same general weapons loadout as the stock variants, but considerably upgrades the internal systems and electronics of the '机甲. The one big change is the removal of the Flamer to instead add more 装甲 plates. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这台定制的梅林C型保留了标准型号的大体武器配置，但大幅升级了机甲的内部系统与电子设备。最大的改动是拆除火焰喷射器，改为增加装甲板。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Based on specs from Operation Trapdoor, the 45 ton Rattlesnake II is a 10 ton upgrade of the original Rattlesnake 机甲. Built by 海狐氏族 for the AFFS during the waning years of the Dark Age, the RSN-2 is powered by a 315-rated Clan XL引擎. 9 tons of Stealth 装甲 and a 守护者ECM suite protect the 机甲. A sextet of of 中型激光s form the bulk of the 机甲s arsenal with a Small Laser rounding out the weapons. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 根据陷阱门行动的规格，45吨的响尾蛇II是在原版响尾蛇机甲基础上增加10吨的升级型。它由海狐氏族在黑暗时代末期为AFFS建造，RSN-2由315级氏族XL引擎驱动。9吨隐形装甲和守护者ECM套件保护机体。六门中型激光器构成机甲武器库的主体，另有一门小型激光器补足火力。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A Draconis Combine 开发 Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL引擎 allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of 装甲 and 36 tons of weapons. The 分裂 SD1-OF is armed with 5 Clan LRM-5’s and 6 Thunderbolt-5’s. A Clan ER 中型激光器 acts as a secondary weapon. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 苏达是由龙骧联合开发的全向机甲，基于逆向工程的洛基与雷神全向机甲。360级XL引擎让它能够携带15台双重散热器、16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。苏达SD1-OF装备5具氏族LRM-5和6具雷霆火箭-5，并以一门氏族ER中型激光器作为副武器。 特性：延长躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A radical departure from the prime configuration, this configuration strips out all of the weapons, replacing them with an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser in the right arm, a pair of ER 中型激光s in the center torso and Gauss Rifle in the left arm. The C Configuration also mounts a 定位 Computer in the right torso. 怪癖: 受保护的驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 这是一种彻底偏离基础配置的改型：拆除全部武器，右臂换装一门改进型重型大型激光器，中央躯干安装两门ER中型激光器，左臂安装高斯步枪。C型配置还在右侧躯干安装了一台瞄准计算机。 特性：受保护的驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A 28th century 设计 that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech 设计ed for brawling. The DRG-5F is armed with a Gauss Rifle and an LB-10X, with an ER Large Laser and a pair of 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL引擎, 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous and an Endo Steel Skeleton provide the weight needed for the heavy payload, while CASE II and 守护者ECM add to the 设计s survivability. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 龙火是一台28世纪设计、于3058年首次量产的75吨近战机甲。DRG-5F装备高斯步枪和LB-10X，并以ER大型激光器和两门中型X脉冲激光器作为副武器。300级XL引擎、轻型铁纤维装甲和远端钢骨架为其沉重的武器负载提供所需重量，CASE II与守护者ECM则提高了机甲的生存能力。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A 28th century 设计 that first saw production in 3058, the Dragon Fire is a 75-ton mech 设计ed for brawling. The DRG-7K is armed with an ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle, with a Large VSPL and a pair of 中型激光s as secondary weapons. A 300-rated XL引擎 and an Endo-Steel Skeleton provide the weight needed for the heavy payload. 弹道强化装甲 Armour and a Supercharger improve survivability. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 龙火是一台28世纪设计、于3058年首次量产的75吨近战机甲。DRG-7K装备ER PPC和高斯步枪，并以一门大型VSPL和两门中型激光器作为副武器。300级XL引擎与远端钢骨架为其沉重的武器负载提供所需重量，弹道强化装甲和增压器提高了生存能力。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A Dark Age re设计 of the Firebee, the WI-WAM is a Militia 机甲 deployed by Cappellan planetary defense units. Built with Industrial grade components, the WI-WAM is built around a 105-rated Fuel Cell and is armed with a 雷电10 and an RL-20. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 0.73 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 火蜂的黑暗时代重新设计型WI-WAM是一台由卡佩兰行星防卫部队部署的民兵机甲。它采用工业级组件，以105级燃料电池为核心，装备一门雷电10和一具RL-20。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: Intended for close-in combat, the Hammerhead Prime has 15 tons of hardened 装甲 to help resist damage. As a result, the '机甲 is not heavily armed, its arsenal only consists of a mix of medium and close range weapons. The main gun is a 大型脉冲激光, while an Extended Range 中型激光 and a 锁定式SRM-6 launcher allow the 机甲 to handle an opponent once the Hammerhead closes in to short range 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: 锤头Prime旨在近距离战斗，配备15吨硬化装甲以抵御伤害。因此，它没有携带大量武器，武器库仅由中程和近程武器组成。主炮是一门大型脉冲激光器，远程中型激光器与锁定式SRM-6发射器则使机甲在接近短距离后能够应对敌人。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: The center torso carries a Heavy PPC and this is supplemented by a Gauss rifle with two tons of ammunition in the left torso. To protect against capacitor explosions, CASE II is mounted in the left torso as well. Each side torso carries a 中型X脉冲激光 Laser. 特性：战斗拳套 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 中央躯干搭载一门重型PPC，左侧躯干则配备一挺高斯步枪和两吨弹药。为防止电容爆炸，左侧躯干同样安装了CASE II。两侧躯干各携带一门中型X脉冲激光器。 特性：战斗拳套 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of firepower and 装甲 over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL引擎 and features a mix of Endo Steel and 铁纤维装甲; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox ID is armed with an Improved Heavy Large Laser and an Advanced AMS. A pair of ER 中型脉冲激光s and an a Watchdog CEWS round out the variant. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 狐式是轻型氏族全向机甲。30吨的狐式由云蛇氏族于2890年推出，偏重火力与装甲而牺牲速度，由180级XL引擎驱动，并混合采用远端钢与铁纤维装甲，提供16吨模块舱位。狐式ID装备一门改进型重型大型激光器和一套高级AMS，两门ER中型脉冲激光器与一套看门狗CEWS完善了这一配置。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Kobold IIC is protected by 改进的 Stealth 装甲 and carries an ECM Suite, Light TAG, and 轻型 Machine Gun. It is also equipped with a VTOL movement system to increase its utility as a spotter. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 0.9475 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: 小妖IIC由改进型隐形装甲保护，并携带ECM套件、轻型TAG和轻型机枪。它还配备VTOL移动系统，以提升作为观测手的实用性。 特性：改进型通信 部署费用倍率：0.9475 可搭载全向单位，可以近战，可以群聚。

column1: A 90 ton Assault Mech, the Mad Cat Mk II is a 钻石鲨 redesign of the Timber Wolf introduced in 3061 and intended for export to other Clans. Powered by a 360-rated XL引擎, the Mad Cat Mk II 7 is armed with a pair of HAG/20’s and a pair of Streak LRM-10’s. A pair of ER 中型激光s act as backup weapons. 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 狂猫MK II是一台90吨突击机甲，是钻石鲨氏族在3061年推出、计划出口至其他氏族的林狼改型。它由360级XL引擎驱动，狂猫MK II 7装备两门HAG/20和两具Streak LRM-10，两门ER中型激光器作为备用武器。 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A Jihad-era variant, the 2X retains the LB 10-X and Medium Pulse Laser of the 1X while carrying a larger MRM-40 rack enhanced by an experimental Apollo FCS. The remaining weaponry is replaced with a Heavy PPC and a C3 slave. A Compact Gyro increases survivability. 特性：Easy to Maintain 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 这是一个圣战时代的改型。2X保留1X的LB 10-X和中型脉冲激光器，并搭载由实验型Apollo火控系统强化的更大MRM-40发射架。其余武器被重型PPC和C3从属计算机取代，紧凑型陀螺仪提升了生存能力。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower

column1: The Boggart ultraheavy Proto机甲 was 开发 by The Society as a flanker and harasser unit. It's relatively high ground speed is coupled with a 150 meter jumping capability to allow it to quickly engage multiple foes. The single 等离子炮 mounted on the Boggart is particularly effective against overheating '机甲s. Conventional infantry and 车辆s are also quickly damaged by the weapon. 怪癖: Fearsome 掉落成本乘数: 0.982
column2: 博格特超重型原型机是由社会开发的侧翼骚扰单位。它拥有相当高的地面速度，并具备150米跳跃能力，可以迅速接战多个敌人。机体上唯一的等离子炮对付过热的机甲尤其有效，也能迅速杀伤普通步兵和车辆。 特性：威慑 部署成本倍率：0.982

column1: The Boggart ultraheavy Proto机甲 was 开发 by The Society as a flanker and harasser unit. It's relatively high ground speed is coupled with a 150 meter jumping capability to allow it to quickly engage multiple foes. This variant of the Boggart replaces the 等离子炮 and ammunition with seven Extended Jump Jets and more 装甲. The only weapon mounted on the Boggart 2 is a 中型脉冲激光. 怪癖: Fearsome 掉落成本乘数: 0.982
column2: Boggart 超重型原型机甲由社会开发，作为侧翼骚扰单位使用。它较高的地面速度配合 150 米跳跃能力，使其能够迅速接敌并牵制多个目标。Boggart 2 以七具扩展跳跃喷射器和更多装甲替换原有的武器与弹药。Boggart 2 唯一安装的武器是一具小型脉冲激光器。 特性: 令人胆怯 部署费用倍率: 0.982

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier 装甲 and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 280-rated XL引擎, the Cicada 3X is armed with a pair of 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers and a pair of MML-7’s. Stealth 装甲 and 守护者ECM round out the variant. 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 蝉式于 2740 年推出，是 40 吨级、用于与 Locus 竞争的机甲。它的武装略强而速度相同，更厚的装甲和更出色的近战能力使其能够有效猎杀轻型机甲并执行侦察任务。蝉式 3X 由 280 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对 X 脉冲大型激光器和一对 MML-7。潜行装甲与守护者 ECM 完善了这套配置。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Developed in 3057, the 65 ton Dig Lord Industrial Mech is a heavier version of the older Dig King. The RCL-Z1 ‘‘Deep Lord’’ is a custom modified variant of the Dig Lord used exclusively by the Calderon Protectorate as a Militia Mech. Powered by a 195-rated Fuel Cell, the Mech is armed with a turret mounted Heavy Rifle and an MML-5. A Vibroblade with an Actuator Enhancement System gives the Mech some close combat capabilities. 特性：Improved Lifesupport 部署费用倍率：0.82
column2: 挖掘领主工业机甲于 3057 年开发，是老式挖掘王的重型版本。RCL-Z1“深渊领主”是挖掘领主的定制改型，仅由卡尔德隆保护国作为民兵机甲使用。该机甲由 195 级燃料电池驱动，装备炮塔安装的重型步枪和一具 MML-5。带执行器增强系统的振动刃赋予它一定的近战能力。 特性：改进型生命维持 部署费用倍率：0.82

column1: Like the other Capellan variant, the 7L uses Stealth 装甲 and the attendant 守护者ECM, along with 三重肌纤维束s to take advantage of the high heat levels, all powered by a standard 引擎. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 与其他卡佩兰改型一样，7L 使用潜行装甲和配套的守护者 ECM，并配备冷却夹套，以利用较高的热量水平；所有设备均由标准引擎驱动。 特性: 改进型冷却夹套 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: An experimental reworking of the Gallant's original weapons array 开发 by Federated Suns, this variant featured a pair of 雷电10 Launchers in place of the 大型脉冲激光s. The '机甲's secondary weapon systems were exchanged for four 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers. CASE was added to protect the ammunition for the Thunderbolt Launchers. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: 这是对 Gallant 原有武器阵列的实验性重制，由联邦太阳联合会完成。该改型以一对雷霆 10 发射器替换原有的小型脉冲激光器。Gallant 的副武器系统改为四具 X 脉冲大型激光器，并加装 CASE 保护雷霆发射器的弹药。 特性: 稳定武器 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: An experimental prototype 开发 by Arc-Royal 机甲Works, this version used a Torso-Mounted Cockpit, 轻型引擎, and Endo Steel skeleton as the frame to carry six 改进的 Jump Jets. The standard weaponry is replaced with a head mounted 中型脉冲激光 and a 浮夸激光 in each arm. To find its opponents, the head also carries a 血猎犬主动探头. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.12
column2: 这是由 Arc-Royal 机甲工坊开发的实验原型机，采用躯干安装式驾驶舱、轻型引擎和内骨骼钢框架，并搭载六具改进型跳跃喷射器。标准武器被替换为头部安装的中型脉冲激光器，以及双臂各一具浮夸激光器。头部还配备血猎犬主动探头，用于发现敌人。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.12

column1: The personal Battle 装甲 设计 of former General Anori McFaris, member of the Mercenary outfit The Silent Reapers. By using improved stealth 装甲 the unit is much easier concealed, allowing it to sneak up on its foes and unleash its Flamer and Machine Gun at close range. 怪癖: 信息收集者 掉落成本乘数: 0.906 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: 这是前将军 Anori McFaris 的私人战斗机甲，她是雇佣兵组织The Silent Reapers的成员。通过使用改进型潜行装甲，该单位更容易隐藏，能够悄悄接近敌人并在近距离释放火焰喷射器和机枪。 怪癖: 信息接收器 掉落成本乘数: 0.906 可由 Omni units, 进行战斗, 氏族部队.

column1: A Clan built upgrade of the Guillotine, the Guillotine IIC is assigned to second line units and solahma troops. The Guillotine IIC-2 is armed with a quartet of ER 中型激光器 and an ER PPC, backed up by a Streak SRM-4 for close range engagements. A Targeting Computer enhances the mech’s accuracy and Improved Jump Jets increase it’s mobility. 特性：Integrated Searchlight 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Upper
column2: 断头台的氏族升级型，断头台 IIC 被分配给第二线部队和消耗者部队。断头台 IIC-2 装备四具 ER 大型激光器和一具 ER PPC，并以 Streak SRM-4 负责近距离交战。瞄准计算机提高机甲的命中精度，改进型跳跃喷射器则提升机动性。 特性：集成探照灯 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Upper

column1: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or 装甲, the Hellbringer is a Clan 全向Mech. Powered by a 325-rated XL引擎, the Hellbringer has 28.5 tons of pod space. The Hellbringer D is armed with a pair of Plasma Cannons. A Micro Pulse Laser, pair of B-Pods and 4 Medium Pulse Lasers cover close range combat. 特性：Integrated Searchlight 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Hellbringer 是一台 65 吨级设计，以压倒性火力优先于速度和装甲，是氏族全能机甲。它由 325 级 XL 引擎驱动，拥有 28.5 吨 pod 空间。Hellbringer D 装备一对等离子炮；微型脉冲激光器、一对 B-Pod 和四具中型脉冲激光器负责近距离战斗。 特性：集成探照灯 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: First 生产 in 2948, the Ice Ferret is a medium scout Omni机甲 often employed as a head hunter or strike unit. A 45 ton Clan Omni机甲, the Ice Ferret is powered by a 360-rated XL引擎 and has 9.5 tons of pod space thanks to a combination of Endo Steel, an XL引擎 and 铁纤维装甲. The Ice Ferret IFR-L is armed with a 等离子炮 and a trio of AP Gauss Rifles. A 定位 Computer improves the accuracy of the weapons. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 冰鼬首次于 2948 年生产，是一种中型侦察全能机甲，常用于猎杀首脑或执行突击任务。45 吨的氏族全能机甲冰鼬由 360 级 XL 引擎驱动，凭借内骨骼钢、XL 引擎和铁纤维装甲的组合获得 9.5 吨 pod 空间。冰鼬 IFR-L 装备一具反人员高斯步枪和三具 AP 高斯步枪。瞄准计算机提高武器精度。 特性: 改进型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The first Clantech OmniMech produced by Odin Manufacturing for the 鬼熊 Dominion, the Karhu (Finnish for "Bear") earned the reputation as a fast cavalry 'Mech. Built on an Endo Steel based chassis, powered by a 325-rated XL引擎 and clad in ten and half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the Karhu featured respectable speed and 装甲 for its size while providing thirty tons of available pod space for equipment. Twelve 双散热器 coped with most of the waste heat of its varied configurations.
column2: Karhu（芬兰语意为“熊”）是 Odin 制造公司为蛇夫座自治领生产的第一款氏族科技全能机甲，并因速度快而赢得骑兵机甲的声誉。它采用内骨骼钢底盘，由 325 级 XL 引擎驱动，覆盖十吨半铁纤维装甲；在该吨位下拥有可观的速度和装甲，同时提供 30 吨可用 pod 空间。十二具双散热器足以处理各种配置产生的大部分余热。

column1: One of the earliest second generation OmniMech designs, the Kingfisher debuted in 2887 and is reputed to have influenced all subsequent Clan Assault OmniMech designs. A 90-ton mech powered by a 360-rated Fusion 引擎, the Kingfisher has 24 tons of podspace provided by a combination of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and an Endo Steel skeleton. The Kingfisher F is armed with a HAG/30 and an ER Large Laser. At closer ranges, the F can bring to bear a trio of ER 中型激光s.
column2: Kingfisher 是最早的第二代全能机甲设计之一，于 2887 年首次亮相，并被认为影响了此后所有氏族突击全能机甲的设计。这台 90 吨机甲由 360 级聚变引擎驱动，凭借铁纤维装甲和内骨骼钢框架组合提供 24 吨 pod 空间。Kingfisher F 装备 HAG/30 和 ER 大型激光器；在近距离，F 型还可使用三具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of firepower and 装甲 over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL引擎 and features a mix of Endo Steel and 铁纤维装甲; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox F is armed with a HAG/20 and a pair of 中型脉冲激光s. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 轻型氏族全能机甲，30 吨的 Kit Fox 于 2890 年由云蛇氏族推出。Kit Fox 注重火力与装甲而牺牲速度，由 180 级 XL 引擎驱动，采用内骨骼钢和铁纤维装甲组合，提供 16 吨 pod 空间。Kit Fox F 装备 HAG/20 和一对中型脉冲激光器。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This variant is equipped with Stealth 装甲 powered by a 守护者ECM Suite. The weapons have been replaced so it carries a Heavy PPC, Gauss Rifle, and three 火箭发射器 10s. The heat sinks have been increased to fourteen. To make room for all this equipment, the 4E uses an XL Gyro and a 小型驾驶舱.
column2: 该改型装备由守护者 ECM 套件驱动的潜行装甲。武器经过更换，改为重型 PPC、高斯步枪和三具 LRM-10。散热器增加到十四具。为容纳这些设备，4E 使用 XL 陀螺仪和小型驾驶舱。

column1: Still an infantry killer, the IIC 7 mounts a trio of Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles in each arm. One meager ton of ammunition supplies this variant. The ER 中型激光 of the IIC 4 remains in place. A 定位 Computer enhances these weapons' accuracy. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: IIC 7 仍然是一台反步兵机甲，双臂各安装三具反人员高斯步枪。该改型仅配备一吨弹药。IIC 4 的 ER 中型激光器继续保留，并由瞄准计算机提高这些武器的精度。 特性: 窄小/低矮 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A Star League era fire support platform, the 长bow is an 85 ton Assault 机甲 and one of the most used fire support mechs in existence. The LGB-13C is armed with a sextet of LAC-5’s, supported by a pair of ER 中型激光s and an ER Small. 2 B-Pods are installed in the legs with a C3 Slave and a 守护者ECM Suite also installed. A 255-rated 引擎, DHS and an Endo Steel chassis round out the design.
column2: 弓手是星盟时代的火力支援平台，属于 85 吨突击机甲，也是现存使用最广泛的火力支援机甲之一。LGB-13C 装备六具 LAC-5，并由两具 ER 中型激光器和一具 ER 小型激光器提供支援。双腿安装了两具 B-Pod，此外还装有 C3 从属单元和守护者 ECM 套件。255 级引擎、双散热器和内骨骼钢底盘完善了这一设计。

column1: The D configuration is effective at all ranges with an all-energy loadout that gives it the ability to operate beyond the range of supply lines. Two Light PPCs have the longest range of the Luminos' weapons. This variant also carries a pair of ER 中型激光器, giving it a very small window where its four largest guns overlap optimal ranges. Should the Malak D find itself inside the minimum range of the PPCs, it can utilize three ER Small Lasers.
column2: D 配置采用全能量武器装载，在所有距离都有效，使其能够脱离补给线持续作战。两具轻型 PPC 是 Luminos 武器中射程最远的。该改型还携带两具 ER 中型激光器，使四门主炮的最佳射程只有很小一段重叠区域。如果 Malak D 进入 PPC 的最小射程，它可以使用三具 ER 小型激光器。

column1: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Marauder II MAD-5W is armed with a Heavy PPC and a pair of Snub Nose PPC’s. C3i and 改进型跳跃推进器 round out the variant.\n\n部署费用倍率：1.18.
column2: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。掠夺者 II MAD-5W 由 300 级聚变核心驱动，装备重型 PPC 和一对短管 PPC；C3i 与改进型跳跃喷射器完善了这套配置。\n\n部署费用倍率：1.18.

column1: A 氏族钻石鲨 variant, the Medusa 5 retains three SRM-6 launchers but upgrades them with Artemis IV fire control systems. The remaining weapons payload is dropped in favor of a pair of newly developed 等离子炮s, one in each arm. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是一个玉鹰氏族改型，Medusa 5 保留三具 SRM-6 发射器，但为其升级了 Artemis IV 火控系统。其余武器载荷被取消，换成一对新开发的中型脉冲激光器，双臂各一具。 特性：标准瞄准增强 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The Kurita '机甲 设计ers tried solving their lack of a modern light '机甲 by throwing all the latests tech at it. I am not sure they fully succeeded, or this variant would have been actually mass-生产.
column2: Kurita 的机甲设计师试图把所有最新技术都塞进这台现代轻型机甲，以解决他们缺少现代轻型机甲的问题。我不确定他们是否真正成功了，否则这个改型本应投入大规模生产。

column1: The latest variant from Wakazashi is protected by 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 on the Endo Steel chassis. The ER PPC is flanked by two 锁定式SRM-4s. Even with that, ten double heat sinks are able to keep heat levels under control.
column2: Wakazashi 的最新改型在内骨骼钢底盘上使用轻型铁纤维装甲保护。ER PPC 两侧各有一具锁定式 SRM-4。即便如此，十具双散热器仍足以控制热量水平。

column1: Based on the Golden Age Storm Giant, the Scylla is an updated model 开发 by the Steel Vipers as a second line Battlemech. A 100-ton mech with a 400-rated XL引擎, the Scylla SCY-2 is armed with a pair of HAG-20’s. A 小型脉冲激光, a pair of 中型脉冲激光s and a pair of ER 中型激光s deter opponents from closing range with the Scylla. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Scylla 以黄金时代的风暴巨人为基础，由钢蛇氏族开发为第二线战斗机甲的更新型号。这台 100 吨机甲由 400 级 XL 引擎驱动，Scylla SCY-2 装备一对 HAG-20。微型脉冲激光器、一对中型脉冲激光器和一对 ER 中型激光器阻止敌人接近 Scylla。 特性: 坚固 部署费用倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Based on the lighter Shadow Cat Omni机甲, the Shadow Cat II is a heavy 玉鹰氏族 fire-support Battle机甲. The Shadow Cat II features a HAG/20 in the right arm, an LRM10 in each side torso, and an ER 中型激光 in the right torso. Aiding in mobility, the battlemech is also equipped with six jump jets. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: Shadow Cat II 以较轻的 Shadow Cat 全能机甲为基础，是一台重型星蝰氏族火力支援战斗机甲。Shadow Cat II 右臂装备 HAG/20，左右侧面躯干各有一具 LRM-10，右侧躯干另有一具 ER 中型激光器。为提高机动性，这台战斗机甲还装备六具跳跃喷射器。 特性: 窄小/低矮 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium Omni机甲 开发 by 氏族新星猫 to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. This Jihad-era configuration mounts a total of 6 AP Gauss Rifles and a HAG/20. It uses a Light Probe to scout for enemy infantry forces.
column2: Shadow Cat 是一台武装厚重且机动灵活的中型全能机甲，由钻石鲨氏族开发，在 31 世纪初为“复兴行动”准备期间替换冰鼬。本款圣战时代配置共装有六具反人员高斯步枪和一具 HAG/20，并使用轻型探针侦察敌方步兵。

column1: The Siren Proto机甲 was originally 设计ed by 烟虎氏族 to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. Siren 4 is armed with a torso mounted ER Micro Laser and its speed was increased with the use of Proto机甲 人造肌助推器. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.96
column2: Siren 原型机最初由太阳神联盟开发，作为侦察单位使用。它的高速使其能够冲到前方、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，并在敌人察觉前撤离。Siren 4 装备一具安装在躯干上的 ER 微型激光器，并通过原型机跳跃推进器提高速度。 特性: 灵巧 部署费用倍率: 0.96

column1: A Draconis Combine 开发 Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL引擎 allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of 装甲 and 36 tons of weapons. The 分裂 SD1-OX is armed with a 4 增强型LRM-5’s and 2 增强型LRM-10’s. 3 ER 中型激光s a 中型脉冲激光 act as secondary weapons. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: Sunder 是一台龙马联邦氏族全能机甲，基于逆向工程的 Loki 和 Thor 全能机甲。360 级 XL 引擎使其能够携带 15 具双散热器、16.5 吨装甲和 36 吨武器。Sunder SD1-OX 装备 4 具远程制导 LRM-5 和 2 具远程制导 LRM-10；3 具 ER 中型激光器与一具中型脉冲激光器作为副武器。 特性: 伸展躯干扭转 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The long range of this 'Mech's two arm-mounted Gauss Rifles is augmented by a sophisticated 瞄准计算机 that allows it to fire accurately even while on the run. The simple armament is designed to provide withering fire as often and as accurately as possible. 特性：驱动器防护 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这台机甲双臂安装的高斯步枪拥有很远射程，并由先进的瞄准计算机辅助，即使在移动中也能准确射击。简单的武装设计旨在尽可能频繁且精准地倾泻火力。 特性：强化传感器 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Introduced during the Jihad in 3068, this variant of the '机甲 bases its capabilities on ballistic type weapons. Its main weapon is a Class 40 超重型突击高斯 Rifle with six tons of ammunition. The '机甲's alternate weapons are a single ER 中型激光 and a Class 20 LB-X Autocannon with three tons of ammunition. This variant has also been given added protection in the form of an ECM Suite. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.21
column2: 这个改型于 3068 年圣战期间推出，其能力建立在弹道武器之上。主武器是一门 40 型超重型突击高斯步枪，配备六吨弹药。机甲的替代武器是一具 ER 中型激光器和一门 20 型 LB-X 自动炮，配备三吨弹药。此外，该改型还加装 ECM 套件以提升防护。 特性: 扰乱 部署费用倍率: 1.21

column1: This Victor variant emerged during the Jihad. Equipped with five 改进的 Jump Jets, it can rapidly close with enemy forces to bring its Autocannon/20 into play. Six tons of ammunition allow the pilot to choose from many types of special ammunition. The only drawback to this model is that it only has a single 中型激光 for backup. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 这个维克多改型诞生于圣战期间。它装备五具改进型跳跃喷射器，可以迅速接近敌军并使用 AC/20。六吨弹药让驾驶员能够选择多种特殊弹药。该型号唯一的缺点是只有一具中型激光器作为备用武器。 怪癖: 坚固 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: The Void is a battle 装甲 design that is produced by the Draconis Combine. The Void is protected by stealth 装甲 and is a fairly mobile jump-capable battle 装甲. Armed with a single Support PPC, the Void is capable of moderate suppressing fire against larger targets. The stealth 装甲 ensures it takes minimal return fire and the Support PPC guarantees the Void is useful on most battlefields.
column2: 虚空是一款由龙马联邦生产的战斗机甲设计。它由潜行装甲保护，是一台机动性不错并具备跳跃能力的战斗机甲。虚空装备一具支援 PPC，能够对大型目标实施中等强度的压制火力。潜行装甲确保它承受的还击火力极少，而支援 PPC 则保证虚空在大多数战场上都能发挥作用。

column1: A somewhat mediocre Scout and Light Strike platform, the Whitworth has been in service across the Inner Sphere since the end of the Age of War. A 40-ton 机甲, the Whitworth is powered by a 160-rated Fusion Core and mounts 5 改进的 Jump Jets. The Whitworth WTH-K is armed with a pair of MML-7’s. A C3 Slave rounds out the variant.
column2: Whitworth 是一台性能中等的侦察与轻型突击平台，自战争时代结束以来一直服役于内圈。40 吨的 Whitworth 由 160 级聚变核心驱动，并安装五具改进型跳跃喷射器。Whitworth WTH-K 装备一对 MML-7；C3 从属单元完善了这套配置。

column1: The combination of a snub-nose PPC and two light PPCs is a decent loadout, combining with a supercharged 245 XL引擎 actually makes a good flanker.
column2: 短管 PPC 与两具轻型 PPC 的组合构成了可靠的武器装载；配合增压型 245 级 XL 引擎后，它实际上是一台出色的侧翼机甲。

column1: This variant was introduced during the throes of the Jihad. The H-11 is armed with a pair of 等离子步枪s, one in each arm, with four tons of ammunition feeding from the center torso. An 5-Tubed Multi-Missile Launchers is mounted in each of the side torsos, with 2 tons of CASE protected ammunition for each launcher. The left arm mounts the '机甲's energy weapons, which consists of two standard 中型激光s and a single 中型脉冲激光.
column2: 这个改型于圣战最激烈的时期推出。H-11 双臂各装有一具重型自动炮，中央躯干储存四吨弹药。左右侧面躯干各安装一具五管多用途导弹发射器，每具发射器配备两吨由 CASE 保护的弹药。左臂安装该机甲的能量武器，包括两具标准中型激光器和一具中型脉冲激光器。

column1: Not designed for traditional combat, the Carrier is a force multiplier. Designed to support allies from range, the Carrier can hang back behind friendly lines where its lack of 装甲 isn't a concern. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 180 30 左侧 120 30 右侧 120 30 后方 60 30 总计 480 120 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: 运输车并非为传统战斗而设计，而是用于放大部队整体战力。它经过设计，可以从远处支援友军；即使装甲薄弱，也能在友军战线后方待机。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 180 30 左侧 120 30 右侧 120 30 后方 60 30 总计 480 120 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: Introduced in 3072, the common 装甲 is replaced with 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 to increase protection. This variant has also an AMS to increase the defense capabilities of the vehicle. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 215 40 左侧 145 40 右侧 145 40 后方 100 40 炮塔 160 40 总计 765 200 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: 该型号于 3072 年推出，以铁纤维装甲替换普通装甲以增加防护。这个改型还配备 AMS，以提升车辆的防御能力。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 215 40 左侧 145 40 右侧 145 40 后方 100 40 炮塔 160 40 总计 765 200 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: Introduced in 3068 and used by the 球体共和国, this variant used twin ER PPCs and four ER 中型激光s to provide heavy firepower at all ranges. This version of the Rifleman also had a higher top speed (86 km/h) thanks to a Light Fusion 引擎.
column2: 这个改型于 3068 年推出并由星云联邦使用，采用双 ER PPC 和四具 ER 中型激光器，在所有距离提供强大火力。得益于轻型聚变引擎，该型号 Rifleman 的最高速度也提高到 86 km/h。

column1: Introduced in 3068 and used by the 球体共和国, this variant used twin ER PPCs and four ER 中型激光s to provide heavy firepower at all ranges. This version of the Rifleman also had a higher top speed (86 km/h) thanks to a Light Fusion 引擎. 特性：防空瞄准系统 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这个改型于 3068 年推出并由星云联邦使用，采用双 ER PPC 和四具 ER 中型激光器，在所有距离提供强大火力。得益于轻型聚变引擎，该型号 Rifleman 的最高速度也提高到 86 km/h。 特性：集成瞄准系统 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Pit Viper B configuration is built for close-quarters brawling, featuring dual Streak SRM-6 racks—each with one ton of ammo—backed by an AMS and four ER 中型激光器 in the torso. This loadout lets the Pit Viper B unleash devastating alpha strikes on nearby foes. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署费用倍率：1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Pit Viper B配置专为近距离缠斗打造，配备两具Streak SRM-6发射器，每具携带一吨弹药；躯干中还有四门ER中型激光器和一套AMS提供支援。这套配置能让Pit Viper B对附近敌人发动毁灭性的全弹齐射。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署费用倍率：1.01 经Aries游戏与模型工作室许可使用。

column1: The Sidewinder D configuration is a powerful mid-range striker armed with five ER 中型激光s all linked to a 定位 Computer, providing precision and sustained firepower to dominate opponents at medium distances. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sidewinder D配置是一台强力的中程突击机甲，装备五门ER中型激光器，全部连接至瞄准计算机，可在中距离提供精确而持续的火力，压制对手。 怪癖: 灵活 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 经Aries游戏与模型工作室许可使用。

column1: The Sidewinder Prime configuration is a versatile skirmisher equipped with an ER Large Laser for long-range attacks and an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光 for close combat. Both weapons link to a 定位 Computer for superior accuracy. It handles heat efficiently, allowing Alpha Strikes at full speed without overheating, making the Sidewinder Prime a popular choice for scouts. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sidewinder Prime配置是一台用途多样的游击机甲，装备一门ER大型激光器用于远程攻击，以及一门改进型重型中型激光用于近战。两种武器都连接至瞄准计算机，以获得更高精度。它具备出色的散热能力，即使全速作战也能发动全弹齐射而不过热，因此Sidewinder Prime深受侦察部队欢迎。 怪癖: 灵活 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 经Aries游戏与模型工作室许可使用。

column1: The Wulfgar Prime configuration mirrors the classic Glass Spider layout but upgrades its firepower with twin Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifles. This variant delivers a heavy long-range punch with superior performance over its predecessor. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Wulfgar Prime配置沿用了经典Glass Spider布局，但以两门20级超重型突击高斯步枪升级火力。该变型能在远距离打出强劲火力，性能优于前代。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 中型 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 经Aries游戏与模型工作室许可使用。

column1: The Raczilla is an attempt at creating the most powerful and supersized mech imaginable. Some think it was accomplished, but it low ammo reserves, and heat 生产 aren't convincing. But doesn't make it less scary...
column2: Raczilla试图打造想象中最强大、体型最大的机甲。有人认为它已经成功，但低弹药储备和散热问题并不能令人信服。不过，这丝毫没有降低它的可怕程度……

column1: One of the more recent additions to the line, the Subjugator 5 builds on the success of the Subjugator 1 by keeping most of the 设计 the same. The only real difference is the replacement of its two Extended Range 大型脉冲激光s with two Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 Launchers and two ER 中型激光s. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.34
column2: Subjugator 5是该系列较新的成员之一，在保留大部分原设计的基础上延续了Subjugator 1的成功。真正的区别在于：用两具装配Artemis IV的LRM-15发射器和两门ER中型激光器，替换原有的两门远程大型脉冲激光器。 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.34

column1: The Mosquito MOS-NCX is a Narc missile beacon testbed, carrying a pod launcher with six charges to mark targets. An LRM 20 with two tons of ammunition follows up on marked foes, backed by a single 中型激光器 for close defense. It relies on hit and run tactics to close and retreat. 特性：精准武器—导弹 部署成本倍率：0.98
column2: Mosquito MOS-NCX是Narc导弹信标试验机，携带一具舱载发射器和六枚充能弹，用于标记目标。一具LRM-20配备两吨弹药，负责追击被标记的敌人；一门中型激光器提供近距离防御。它依靠接近后迅速攻击、再快速撤离的战术作战。 特性：精准武器—导弹 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: The Spiner SPR-SNP-X is a testbed built solely to prove the Snub-Nose PPC on a light frame. Weighing 25 tons with a 150 fusion 引擎, it carries a single center torso mounted Snub-Nose PPC backed by six tons of standard 装甲 for protection. 特性：Accurate Weapon - PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Spiner SPR-SNP-X是专为在轻型机体上验证短管PPC而建造的试验机。它重25吨，由150级聚变引擎驱动，中央躯干安装一门短管PPC，并以六吨标准装甲提供防护。 特性：精准武器—PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The MVN-6M was an attempt to redefine the role of the Merovingian. It removes the Jump Jets but upgrades to a 200 rated 引擎 core, drops the AC/20 in favour of a LBX AC/10 and replaces one of the 中型激光器 with a Large Laser. The final change is the addition of a Small Laser for anti-infantry defense. 特性：﻿Accurate Weapon - AC 部署费用倍率：1.03
column2: MVN-6M试图重新定义Merovingian的作战定位。它拆除跳跃喷射器，升级为200额定引擎核心，以LBX AC/10替换AC/20，并将一门中型激光器替换为大型激光器。最后，它增加一门小型激光器，用于反步兵防御。 特性：精准武器—AC 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Neutron NT-5742r is a common battlefield refit of the NT-5742 that drops the C.A.S.E. protection for another double heat sink, improving its performance in hotter climates. While some MechWarriors complained about the potential for an exploding Gauss Rifle spreading damage to the center torso, most accepted that being able to fire the full loadout more often is usually better for their survival. 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Neutron NT-5742r是NT-5742的常见战场改装型，拆除C.A.S.E.防护并换装另一组双重散热器，从而改善炎热气候下的性能。虽然一些机甲战士担心高斯步枪爆炸可能将伤害扩散到中央躯干，但多数人都接受了一个事实：更频繁地发射完整武器组，通常更有利于生存。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 5 is an experimental variant, trying to introduce 火炮 as part of the line-up with its arm mounted Sniper 火炮. The rest of the loadout is also greatly changed, only the original Gauss Rifle remains, now accompanied by three Extended Range 中型激光器 and one Extended Range PPC. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 5是试验型变体，试图通过安装在手臂上的狙击火炮，将火炮纳入武器阵容。其余配置也大幅改变：原有的高斯步枪得以保留，另增三门远程中型激光器和一门远程PPC。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The MGP-86 is an unconventional Capellan scout built from a patchwork of sourced and stolen technology. Stealth 装甲 powered by a 守护者ECM keeps it invisible to sensors while a 部分机翼 stolen from 玉鹰氏族 extends jump distance well beyond standard capability. Twin ER 中型激光s provide combat punch and an MML 3 with both ammunition types covers additional range brackets when the situation demands it. 怪癖: 短翼 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: MGP-86是非传统的卡佩兰侦察机甲，由采购和窃取来的技术拼装而成。由守护者ECM供能的隐形装甲使它在传感器上难以被发现；一片从玉鹰氏族窃取的部分机翼使其跳跃距离远超标准能力。两门ER中型激光器提供战斗火力，一具MML-3配备两种弹药类型，可在需要时覆盖额外射程。 怪癖: 短翼 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Remix is a one-of-a-kind machine, the first of three Project Rewrite 设计s commissioned by the Centrella granddaughter who took over leadership of the Rangers around 3080, built from a deliberate mix of Jihad-era 布雷克圣言会 salvage and 钻石鲨 Clan technology. That combination is unusual enough on its own, but the 血猎犬主动探头 and Laser AMS together give it a defensive and sensor awareness package you rarely see on a skirmisher this size. It is a reserved-pilot machine, which tells you everything about how the Rangers value it.
column2: Remix是一台独一无二的机器，是3080年前后接掌游骑兵领导权的Centrella家族孙女委托的三个“重写计划”设计之一。它由圣战时期布雷克圣言会的战场残骸与钻石鲨氏族技术有意混合制造。这样的组合本已十分罕见，而血猎犬主动探头与激光AMS又共同提供了这个体型的游击机甲很少具备的防御和传感器感知能力。它是一台为预备驾驶员保留的机体，这足以说明游骑兵有多么重视它。

column1: Developed by 伯洛克氏族 to augment second line units, the Dervish IIC is a rebuild of a number of Star League Dervishes found in a Brian Cache. Eventually spreading to other Clans, the design would prove to be a dependable and tough Mech, with a production line opening in 3000 to meet the Burrocks needs. Armed with a pair of LRM-15's and an ER Large Laser for ranged combat; the 55 ton Dervish IIC-2 is powered by a 275 rated Fusion Core.
column2: Dervish IIC由伯洛克氏族开发，用于增强二线部队，是利用Brian Cache中发现的多台星盟Dervish重建而成。该设计最终传播到其他氏族，并证明是一台可靠而坚韧的机甲；为满足伯洛克氏族需求，生产线于3000年启用。55吨的Dervish IIC-2装备两具LRM-15和一门ER大型激光器用于远程作战，由275额定聚变核心驱动。

column1: An updated version of the CS-2 Fox, the CS-3 was 开发 by 氏族钻石鲨 during the build up to Operation Revival. Still powered by the same 300 rated cXL 引擎 and covered in 10 tons of 铁纤维装甲 armour, the 钻石鲨 engineers simply removed the original ER Large Laser in favour of a third ER 中型激光 and upgrading the 锁定式SRM-2's to 锁定式SRM-4's. 怪癖: Variable Range 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: CS-3是CS-2 Fox的升级型号，由钻石鲨氏族在复兴行动准备期间开发。它仍由同一具300额定cXL引擎驱动，覆盖10吨铁纤维装甲。钻石鲨工程师拆除原有的ER大型激光器，换成第三门ER中型激光器，并将锁定式SRM-2升级为锁定式SRM-4。 怪癖: 可变射程瞄准 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of fire power and 装甲 over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL引擎 and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox D-EWR is s an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. The standard NARC Pod and LRM-5 are removed. With the freed weight, the LRM-15's are upgraded to use the 阿尔忒弥斯IV火控 and a pair of ER 中型激光s added. A 小型脉冲激光 rounds out the configuration.
column2: Kit Fox是一台轻型氏族全向机甲，重30吨，由云蛇氏族于2890年推出。它偏重火力与装甲而牺牲速度，由180级XL引擎驱动，采用内骨骼与铁纤维装甲混合结构，提供16吨舱位。Kit Fox D-EWR是入侵氏族为提升机甲战斗效能而开发的应急改装型。标准NARC发射舱和LRM-5被拆除；腾出的重量用于将LRM-15升级为装配阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的型号，并增装两门ER中型激光器。最后再加装一门小型脉冲激光器完成配置。

column1: The Viper B-EWR is an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. Prompted by a shortage of ER PPC's, Clan Techs swapped in an ER Large Laser and used the remaining free weight to upgrade the Pulse Lasers to Medium models.\n\n部署成本倍率：1.03.
column2: Viper B-EWR是入侵氏族为提升机甲战斗效能而开发的应急改装型。由于ER PPC短缺，氏族技术人员换装一门ER大型激光器，并利用剩余重量将脉冲激光器升级为中型型号。\n\n部署成本倍率：1.03.

column1: The Argus is first and foremost a close combat '机甲. For this reason, the Argus carries a 转管自动炮/5 and a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. The Argus has a single Machine Gun to defend itself against infantry attacks, and an LRM-10 launcher provides the Argus with some long range striking capabilities. The 转管自动炮/5 and the ER 中型激光s are linked to an advanced 定位 Computer which makes them extremely accurate. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Argus首先是一台近战机甲，因此携带一门转管自动炮/5和两门ER中型激光器进行近距离战斗。它还配备一挺机枪，用于抵御步兵攻击；一具LRM-10发射器则赋予Argus一定的远程打击能力。转管自动炮/5和ER中型激光器都连接至先进瞄准计算机，使其精度极高。 怪癖: 灵活 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The personal Battle机甲 of one "Rumia", this unit has been rumored to be able to partially transform itself into a 坦克! The armaments consist of a pair of suspicious-looking MRM40 launchers that someone yanked off of some other '机甲s. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是某位名为“Rumia”的人的私人战斗机甲，据传它能够部分变形为坦克！武器包括两具外观可疑的MRM40发射器，据说是从其他机甲上硬拆下来的。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: Recovered during a raid against the Jade Falcons as a half completed chassis is this 机甲 feared among Outlaws who faced it, being able to strike fast and deadly after it got fitted with Mimetic 装甲 and a Angel ECM. 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右上臂
column2: 这台机甲是在袭击玉鹰氏族时作为半成品底盘回收的，Outlaw们在面对它时无不畏惧。装配拟态装甲和天使ECM后，它能够发动迅猛而致命的打击。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右上臂

column1: The Mad Dog 全向Mech was code-named "Vulture" by the Inner Sphere during the 氏族入侵. Quite how this "Vulture" made it into the hands of pirate MechTechs is probably better left unexplored, especially considering that they had the expertise to restore the 'Mech to full working order ... with a few shortcuts, naturally. 特性：高级光学系统 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Mad Dog全向机甲在氏族入侵期间被内天体方面代号为“Vulture”。这台“Vulture”究竟如何落入海盗机甲技师手中，最好不要深究；更令人惊讶的是，他们竟有能力将这台机甲恢复到完全可用状态——当然，过程中免不了采用一些捷径。 特性：高级光学系统 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: Well, Boss. I've got good news and bad news. The good news is that the 装甲 on this thing is top-of-the-line tech. The bad news is that I have no idea how badly I messed up getting it off. The 装甲, I mean. Why are you grinning?
column2: 好了，老板。这台东西有好消息，也有坏消息。好消息是，它的装甲采用顶级技术。坏消息是，我完全不知道自己把装甲拆下来时搞得有多糟。我是说装甲。你为什么在咧嘴笑？

column1: This Pirate version of the Hoplite includes multiple methods of interfering with another '机甲's entire kit. It comes with a Taser, a Harpoon, and a pair of Fluid Guns that can spray a selection of chemicals on enemy units. It's equipped with a 机甲anical Jump Jet system to get it in and out of range of its targets. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这个海盗版Hoplite拥有多种干扰敌方机甲整套装备的手段。它配备电击器、鱼叉和两具流体枪，可向敌方单位喷射多种化学物质；还装备机械式跳跃喷射系统，以便进出目标射程。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: Developed by Clan 地狱战马 as an insult to 氏族钻石鲨 is this variant of the Mad Cat MKII 设计ed to carry a pair of their newly 开发 experimental RAC5, bringing Sorrow upon any who dare stand in its Way. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是地狱战马氏族为羞辱钻石鲨氏族而开发的Mad Cat MKII变型，搭载两具新开发的实验型RAC5，给任何敢于挡路者带来灾难。 怪癖: 精准 武器 - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Athena is a stealthed heavy fire support platform, based upon the 布雷克圣言会 Archer 9W, 开发 to assist in Black Ops and plausible deniability does it carry a hyperspecialized 作战套件 that takes over the 机甲's passive Computers coupled with a 虚空信号系统s. 怪癖: Command 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.23
column2: Athena是隐形重型火力支援平台，以布雷克圣言会Archer 9W为基础，为黑色行动和可否认行动而开发。它搭载高度专用的作战套件，接管机甲的被动计算机，并与虚空信号系统配合使用。 怪癖: 指挥 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.23

column1: A experimental rebuild of the clan Behemoth/Stone Rhino, this variant is 设计ed around a experimental 引擎 that frees up enough space in the center torso to make full use of its spinal mounted 炮塔 System. 怪癖: Spinal Mount 掉落成本乘数: 1.29 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是氏族Behemoth/Stone Rhino的试验性重建型号，围绕一台能够释放中央躯干空间的实验型引擎设计，以便充分利用安装在脊柱上的炮塔系统。 怪癖: 脊柱安装 掉落成本乘数: 1.29 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of fire power and 装甲 over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL引擎 and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox Z is armed with a Large Supra Laser and an ER Small Laser. A pair of Laser AMS, a Streak Narc and a TAG round out the Society variant. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Kit Fox是一台轻型氏族全向机甲，重30吨，由云蛇氏族于2890年推出。它偏重火力与装甲而牺牲速度，由180级XL引擎驱动，采用内骨骼与铁纤维装甲混合结构，提供16吨舱位。Kit Fox Z装备一门大型Supra激光和一门ER小型激光器；两具激光AMS、一具Streak Narc和一套TAG共同组成Society配置。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This Society configuration of the Mist Lynx features the a pair of Medium Supra Lasers in the torsos and a pair of Small Supra Lasers in the arms. These advanced weapons combined with the Nova CEWS makes the Mist Lynx Z-A an effective skirmisher. 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Society的这一Mist Lynx配置在两侧躯干安装两门中型Supra激光，在双臂安装两门小型Supra激光。这些先进武器与Nova CEWS结合，使Mist Lynx Z-A成为高效的游击机甲。 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Society managed to squeeze in both a 转管自动炮 20 and a Large Supra Laser, making the ERE-PZ the best performing variant of the Erebus. The major downside is the huge price increase by almost a third more c-bills. 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.42 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Society设法同时塞入一门转管自动炮20和一门大型Supra激光，使ERE-PZ成为Erebus中性能最强的变型。主要缺点是价格暴涨，C币成本几乎增加了三分之一。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.42 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: An update to the antiquated Hammerhands, the 5M was 开发 by 明尼苏达部落 engineers in an effort to produce a heavy weapon platform with relatively cheap and easy to produce components. This variant features twin 改进的 AC10s supplemented by an Enhanced ERPPC with two 中型激光s as backup weapons. 怪癖: Barrel Fist 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Hammerhands的过时型号升级版5M由明尼苏达部落工程师开发，目标是制造一台采用相对廉价且易于生产部件的重型武器平台。该变型装备两门改进型AC/10，并以一门增强型ER PPC和两门中型激光器作为备用武器。 怪癖: 炮拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The F loadout is the least used configuration of the Menace, due to its unusual weapons combination. It's whole right arm and torso is filled by a massive 长 Tom 火炮, while the left side of the 机甲 houses Two Extended Range Heavy PPCs, two Large 改进的 Heavy Lasers and three Ultra AC/5. Even a single ER 大型脉冲激光 is mounted in the head. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.42
column2: Menace的F配置因武器组合异常而最少使用。它的整条右臂和右侧躯干都被一门巨大的长汤火炮占据；左侧则装有两门远程重型PPC、两门大型改进型重型激光器和三门Ultra AC/5。甚至头部还安装了一门ER大型脉冲激光器。 怪癖: 稳定 武器s 掉落成本乘数: 1.42

column1: The -Er is a recent refit of the SG11-E to focus more on firepower over ruggedness. By dropping the Binary Lasers in favor of Large Pulser Lasers managed to upgrade the MRM-10 to MRM-30 launchers and adding two ER 中型激光器, and the Heavy Duty Gyro and Reactive Plates have been exchanged for weight saving options. The final change of the refit is the switch to Compact Heat Sinks. 特性：Improved Lifesupport 部署费用倍率：1.4
column2: -Er是SG11-E的最新改装型，重点提升火力而非坚固性。它舍弃二元激光器，改用大型脉冲激光器；同时将MRM-10升级为MRM-30发射器，并增装两门ER中型激光器。重型陀螺仪和反应装甲板也换成了更轻的方案。改装的最后一步是换用紧凑型散热器。 特性：改进型生命保障 部署费用倍率：1.4

column1: The bravo configuration of the Wannu is a combination of missile boat and support '机甲, mounting 80 tubes of LRM missiles and 16 tubes of Mortars. Two 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers and a Re-engineered Small Laser provide direct fire coverage to defend the '机甲. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.32 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: Wannu的Bravo配置兼具导弹平台和支援机甲功能，安装80管LRM导弹和16管迫击炮。两门中型X脉冲激光器与一门重设计小型激光器提供直射火力，用于保护机甲。 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.32 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The B variant is focused on medium to long range burst damage capabilities, carrying a Rotary Autocannon 5 in each arm, paired with a total of three Large Pulse Lasers. Two side torso mounted Light PPC and an AMS Mk2 finishes the armaments of the design. 特性：Command Mech 部署费用倍率：1.35 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: B变型专注于中远距离爆发伤害，每条手臂安装一门转管自动炮5，并配备总共三门大型脉冲激光器。两门安装在侧面躯干的轻型PPC和一套AMS Mk2完成整机武装。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.35 手臂驱动器限制：全向
