column1: The Rifleman 9T is armed with a pair of Light PPCs backed up by a pair of 轻型自动炮/5s for medium range sniping. These are backed up by a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. All of the '机甲's weapons are linked to a 定位 Computer for increased accuracy. The 9T also uses Stealth 装甲, making it much harder to hit at long range. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Rifleman 9T装备一对轻型PPC，配合一对轻型自动炮/5，在中距离进行狙击；另有一对ER中型激光用于近战。机甲的所有武器均连接至定位计算机，以提高命中率。9T还采用隐形装甲，使其在远距离更难被击中。 特性：防空定位 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: The Raven X is a Capellan experimental refit of the Raven-3L upgrading nearly every portion of the 设计. The X3X electronics have been upgraded to an Angel ECM and 血猎犬主动探头, additionally the right arm 中型激光器 have been replaced with upgraded X-Pulse models and the SRM6 has been removed in favor of an Apollo Guided MRM 20 system.  These upgrades come at the cost of the traditional Tag laser and Narc beacon launcher but the result is a capable striker and scout.
column2: Raven X是卡佩兰联邦对Raven-3L进行的实验性改装，几乎升级了设计的每个部分。X3X电子设备升级为天使ECM和猎犬主动探测器，右臂的中型激光器则替换为升级型X脉冲型号，并移除了SRM6，改用阿波罗制导MRM 20系统。这些升级牺牲了传统的TAG激光器和NARC信标发射器，但最终造就了一台能力出色的突击侦察机甲。

column1: First 生产 in 3092, this variant carries the paired ER large lasers of the standard, but mounts dual ATM-6s, each fed by three tons of ammunition. It also adds a ton of 装甲 protection.
column2: 该型号于3092年首次投产，保留标准型号成对的ER大型激光，同时搭载双联ATM-6，每门配备三吨弹药，并额外增加一吨装甲防护。

column1: A Dark Age upgrade of the Centurion 9H, the 9H2H replaces the primitive 引擎 with a standard Fusion 引擎 and upgrades the 装甲 to Heavy Industrial; giving it comparable protection to a Succession Wars era Centurion. The freed weight is used to install an extra 中型激光. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 0.77 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 作为Centurion 9H在黑暗时代的升级型号，9H2H用标准融合引擎替换了老式引擎，并将装甲升级为重型工业装甲，使其拥有与继承战争时期Centurion相当的防护。释放出的重量用于安装一门额外的中型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.77 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: A post Jihad re设计, the Commando 8S uses an Endo Steel chassis and XL引擎. A pair of 锁定式SRM-2 launchers are carried in the right arm with a pair of ER 中型激光s in the left arm. The Streak ammunition is stored in a CASE II protected bay. A 增强型C3从机 allows the Commando to share targeting data with friendly forces, and a Supercharger allows it to reach speeds of 140 km/h in short bursts. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.98
column2: 圣战后的重新设计，Commando 8S采用内骨骼钢底盘和XL引擎。右臂装有一对锁定式SRM-2发射器，左臂装有一对ER中型激光。连击弹药存放在CASE II防护舱内。增强型C3从机让Commando能够与友军共享瞄准数据，增压器则使其能在短时间内达到140公里/小时。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Dark Crow 是 Snow Raven 氏族开发的第二线 BattleMech，圣战后仅在 Outworlds Alliance 的内圈设施生产。它以 Dante 上一种奇特的穴居鸟类命名，在第二线部队中很受欢迎。This variant of the Dark Crow appears to be a hybrid of the original Dark Crow and the Dark Crow 2, the ER Large Laser, which has been replaced with a standard Heavy Medium Laser器 and an advanced Targeting Computer, a configuration similar to that found on the Dark Crow 2. 特性：﻿Accurate Weapon - AC 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Dark Crow是雪鸦氏族开发的第二线战斗机甲，圣战后仅在外世界联盟的内圈设施生产。它以Dante上一种奇特的穴居鸟类命名，在第二线部队中很受欢迎。该型号似乎是原版Dark Crow与Dark Crow 2的混合体：用标准重型中型激光器和高级定位计算机替换了ER大型激光，配置与Dark Crow 2相近。 特性：精准武器 - AC 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL引擎 and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of 铁纤维装甲 and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth G is armed with 4 Improved Heavy 中型激光s augmented by a 瞄准计算机. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds.\n\n部署费用倍率：0.98.
column2: 这台20吨级Fire Moth由额定功率200的XL引擎驱动，并配备MASC，是有史以来速度最快的机甲之一。Fire Moth于2874年投产，专为侦察和运载元素战士设计。铁纤维装甲与内骨骼钢的组合为其提供了7.5吨的模块舱空间。Fire Moth G装备4门改进型重型中型激光，并配有瞄准计算机；增压器还能让它达到更高速度。\n\n部署费用倍率：0.98.

column1: Armed with mainly energy weaponry and a single missile launcher, this configuration again takes a page from the older model's configuration by the same name. In the arms is pair of ER Large Lasers and ER Mediums Lasers tied into a 瞄准计算机. The left torso is home of the 15-tubed LRM launcher and its two tons of ammunition. Eight additional 双散热器 and five Jump Jets round out the equipment for this configuration equipment.
column2: 这套配置主要采用能量武器，并配备一具导弹发射器，再次沿用了同名旧型号的设计思路。双臂装有一对ER大型激光和ER中型激光，并接入瞄准计算机。左侧躯干装有15管LRM发射器及两吨弹药。八个额外双联散热器和五具跳跃喷射器完善了这套配置。

column1: An upgrade of the Highlander introduced in 3115, the Highlander 740 is powered by a 270-rated Fusion Core. An ER PPC is paired with an Artemis IV augmented LRM-20 for long range combat, while a 锁定式SRM-6, 2 M-Pods and a pair of ER 中型激光s cover close range combat. 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Highlander的升级型号，于3115年推出，由额定功率270的融合核心驱动。ER PPC与配备阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20搭配，用于远距离作战；锁定式SRM-6、两具M型吊舱和一对ER中型激光则负责近距离作战。 特性：强化腿部 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: The Hippogriff is a 雪鸦氏族 设计, which was created as part of their need for additional ground troops for their Touman. Made as a companion to the Gorgon, the Hippogriff was 设计ed as a mobile light fire support unit. Considered to be a Heavy Proto机甲, the 设计 is lightly armed for its size. Its only weaponry is a pair of LRM-2 Launchers. 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：0.978
column2: Hippogriff是雪鸦氏族的设计，用于满足其战团对额外地面部队的需求。它作为Gorgon的伴随型号制造，被设计为机动轻型火力支援单位。作为重型原型机甲，它以自身吨位而言武装较轻，仅配备一对LRM-2发射器。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：0.978

The Kit Fox I is armed with an ER PPC, an ER 中型激光 and an ER Small Laser. A 瞄准计算机, Supercharger and 模块化装甲 round out the variant.

column2: Lament是一台重型战斗机甲，最初于3120年代末为球体共和国武装部队制造。它在火力与装甲之间取得平衡，因此有人将这台机甲与Warhammer等旧式设计，以及更重型的Awesome突击机甲相提并论。 特性：可变范围定位 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: This version uses an experimental 350-rated XXL 引擎, a Laser Anti Missile System, and a pair of Improved Heavy 中型激光器. The Jade Falcon engineers who designed it also installed an XL Gyro and used Heavy 铁纤维装甲 装甲 to protect the chassis. 特性：Narrow/Low Profile 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂
column2: 该型号采用实验性的350级XXL引擎、激光反导系统和一对改进型重型中型激光。参与设计的玉鹰氏族工程师还安装了XL陀螺仪，并使用重型铁纤维装甲保护底盘。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: 迪法恩斯工业, producing the Locust under license, decided to be bold and modernize the next 设计 heavily. They used their new -7S as a testbed for their homegrown ClanTech components, including the ER 中型激光器 and XL fusion 引擎. The latter is a popular salvage item for those who manage to down this variant, which can reach speeds approaching 200 kilometers an hour 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 迪法恩斯工业获得授权生产Locust后，决定大胆地对下一款设计进行全面现代化改造。他们以自研的-7S作为测试平台，加入ER中型激光器和XL融合引擎等氏族科技部件。后者成为击毁该型号者争相搜寻的热门战利品；这款机甲的速度可接近每小时200公里。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this Battle机甲 is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient 设计. A pair of arm mounted Gauss Rifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 虽然外形与Timberwolf极为相似，但这台战斗机甲是全新而强大的设计。Mad Cat MK II携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极其坚韧的型号。双臂安装的高斯步枪与躯干安装的LRM发射架相互支援，使其能够全面掌控战场。 特性：改进的定位 - 中 部署费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: 这是一台治安官机甲，它让民众安心，但技术含量不高。This variant of the Marshal was introduced during the Dark Age. It carries a TSEMP磁脉冲炮, MML-9 with a three ton ammunition bay, two Machine Guns, a Flamer, a 中型激光, and a 中型脉冲激光. It is otherwise identical to the original Marshal.
column2: 这是一台治安官机甲，能让民众安心，但技术含量并不高。该型号于黑暗时代推出，装备TSEMP磁脉冲炮、配备三吨弹药舱的MML-9、两挺机枪、一具火焰喷射器、一门中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光。除此之外，它与原版Marshal完全相同。

column1: Conceptualised as a long range support platform, the Pendragon was a result of House Davion’s Jihad era MUSE programs. A 95-ton mech, the Pendragon is built around a 380-rated XL引擎 and is loosely based on the Templar Omni机甲. The Pendragon PDR-1R is the first production model and unlike the original prototype is entirely built with Inner Sphere technology. A pair of Extended Range LRM-15’s provide extreme range firepower, while an ER PPC and a trio of ER 中型激光s provide closer ranged firepower.
column2: Pendragon最初被设想为远程支援平台，是达维翁家族在圣战时期MUSE计划的成果。这台95吨级机甲围绕380级XL引擎构建，大体基于Templar全向机甲。Pendragon PDR-1R是首个量产型号，与最初原型不同，它完全采用内圈技术。两具扩展射程LRM-15提供极远距离火力，ER PPC和三门ER中型激光则负责较近距离的火力支援。

column1: Conceptualised as a long range support platform, the Pendragon was a result of House Davion’s Jihad era MUSE programs. column1: Based on the Golden Age Storm Giant, the Scylla is an updated model 开发 by the Steel Vipers as a second line Battlemech. A 100-ton mech with a 400-rated XL引擎, the Scylla SCY-3 is armed with a LB-20X and a HAG-30. An ER PPC and a Heavy Large Laser give the Scylla a heavier punch at range.
column2: Scylla以黄金时代的Storm Giant为基础，由钢蛇氏族开发为第二线战斗机甲的更新型号。这台100吨级机甲配备400级XL引擎；Scylla SCY-3装备LB-20X和HAG-30，ER PPC与重型大型激光则赋予它更强的远程打击力。

column1: Taking a cue from 玉鹰氏族’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility,同时 the remainder maximized armor coverage to see the Clan’s precious OmniMechs and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III primary configuration features a Gauss Rifle in the left arm with three tons of ammo, and a pair of 中型脉冲激光s in the right arm.
column2: Nova Cat科学家借鉴了玉鹰氏族前十年推出的Thor II，移除了原版Shadow Cat的固定跳跃喷射器，以释放宝贵的重量。剩余的大部分吨位分配给模块舱空间，增强机甲的灵活性；其余部分则用于最大化装甲覆盖，确保珍贵的氏族全向机甲及其战士能够安全返航。Shadow Cat III的主配置在左臂安装一挺高斯步枪和三吨弹药，右臂安装一对中型脉冲激光。

column1: Based on the lighter Shadow Cat Omni机甲, the Shadow Cat II is a heavy 玉鹰氏族 fire-support Battle机甲. This variant 开发 in 3089 carries four 锁定式SRM-6 launchers, supplemented by a single ER Large Laser and ER 中型激光. This version is more intended for close in fighting rather than the long range fire support of the original. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: Shadow Cat II基于较轻的Shadow Cat全向机甲，是玉鹰氏族的重型火力支援战斗机甲。该型号于3089年开发，装备四具锁定式SRM-6发射器，另有一门ER大型激光和一门ER中型激光作为补充。与原版的远程火力支援定位相比，该版本更适合近距离作战。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧上臂

column1: Based on the lighter Shadow Cat 全向Mech, the Shadow Cat II is a heavy 玉鹰氏族 fire-support BattleMech. This Dark Age configuration introduced in 3092 carries two LRM-10 launchers and a Gauss Rifle. It removes a single jump jet, which means it can only cover 150 米 per jump.

column1: A dedicated electronic warfare and scout 机甲, the 35 ton Raven has seen continuous service since it entered service in 3024. Powered by a 280-rated XL引擎, the Raven 5L is 装甲ed in Stealth 装甲 and mounts an Angel ECM. Armed with a Narc发射器 and a TAG for spotting and tagging hostile units, the Raven 5L also mounts a pair of ER 中型激光s and 2 SRM-2’s for close range combat. 怪癖: 改进的 Jammer 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Raven是一台专用电子战与侦察机甲，自3024年服役以来持续投入使用。这台35吨级机甲由280级XL引擎驱动，Raven 5L采用隐形装甲，并装有天使ECM。它装备NARC发射器和TAG，用于发现并标记敌方单位；同时配备一对ER中型激光和两具SRM-2，负责近距离作战。 特性：改进型干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: The Karura is a heavy trooper '机甲 introduced in 3084 to replace older 设计s like the Avatar and Dragon. Built for efficiency, two Karuras can be 生产 for the cost of one Avatar. With an XL引擎 and MASC, it can achieve impressive bursts of speed. Though limited beyond 450 米, it excels in close to mid-range combat with a Heavy PPC, two 中型激光s, and CASE-protected 锁定式SRM-6s. Solid 装甲 and flexible battlefield performance make the Karura a reliable frontline workhorse with staying power.
column2: Karura是一台重型突击机甲，于3084年推出，用于替换Avatar和Dragon等老旧设计。它以效率为设计目标，两台Karura的生产成本仅相当于一台Avatar。凭借XL引擎和MASC，它能在短时间内爆发出惊人的速度。虽然在450米以外受到限制，但它凭借重型PPC、两门中型激光和受CASE保护的锁定式SRM-6，在近中距离作战中表现出色。坚固的装甲与灵活的战场性能，使Karura成为持久可靠的前线主力。

column1: The Krait Prime configuration is an agile skirmisher, wielding a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle guided by a 定位 Computer for accurate long-range strikes. Two tons of HAG ammunition support sustained fire, while an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光 and an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser round out its short-range capabilities. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Krait Prime配置是一台敏捷的游击机甲，配备20级超重型突击高斯步枪，并由定位计算机引导，以便进行精准的远程打击。两吨HAG弹药支持持续射击，改进型重型中型激光和改进型重型小型激光则完善了它的短程作战能力。 特性：改进型冷却夹套 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan A configuration is commonly deployed in Beta Galaxy’s Stealth Star formations, utilizing a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle, two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, and a single ER 中型激光 for close to mid-range engagements with strong burst damage potential. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan A配置通常部署于贝塔星区的隐形星队编制中，使用20级超重型突击高斯步枪、两门改进型重型中型激光和一门ER中型激光，在近中距离交战中提供强大的爆发伤害。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan C configuration is optimized for close combat in urban environments. It employs four 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s and a 定位 Computer to devastating effect, aided by a jump capacity of 180 米 and surplus heat dissipation, making it deadly at close range. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan C配置针对城市环境中的近距离作战进行了优化。它使用四门改进型重型中型激光和一台定位计算机，配合180米的跳跃能力与额外散热能力，可在近距离造成毁灭性打击。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan D configuration is a precise medium-range skirmisher. Armed with twin ER 大型脉冲激光s linked to a 定位 Computer, the inherent accuracy of its pulse lasers combined with targeting assistance ensures deadly precision in battle. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan D配置是一台精准的中距离游击机甲。它装备两门ER大型脉冲激光，并连接至定位计算机；脉冲激光本身的高精度结合瞄准辅助，确保其在战斗中实现致命的精准打击。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan Prime configuration is a heavy-hitting 设计 favored by Empire Warriors. It pairs an ER PPC with an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser, offering formidable firepower with minimal heat concerns, making it a reliable and popular skirmisher. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan Prime配置是一台由帝国勇士青睐的重火力设计。它将ER PPC与改进型重型大型激光结合，在极低散热压力下提供强大火力，使其成为可靠而受欢迎的游击机甲。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。
